kyoto_kyoto_diner_nishiki.gf_detail: Ask. Roast beef, smoked dishes and salads beside ajillo with baguette, pasta and quiche (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyoto_diner_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, seafood ajillo, cheese and charcuterie (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyoto_diner_nishiki.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 15:00–22:30; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:30 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 22:00); open daily with occasional irregular closures (Tabelog). Book to dine; phone lines open from 13:00 on weekdays and 11:00 at weekends (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「380円 付き出し（税込）」 — a ¥380 appetizer. Minors are asked not to come after 18:00; high stools are not recommended for children under middle-school age at busy weekends (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay and PayPay (Tabelog). English menu with photos (Tabelog). 36 seats: 15 at the counter, 21 at tables; non-smoking, ashtrays at the barrel seats at the entrance (Tabelog). On Yanagibaba-dori just past Nishiki Market; 5 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyoto_diner_nishiki.notes: [Wine bar & roast beef · by Nishiki Market] A wood-panelled wine bar open from mid-afternoon (noon at weekends), with 160 wines picked by an importer-turned-owner and oven-roasted black-wagyu beef. About ¥4,000–6,000; ¥380 appetizer. Book at weekends; no minors after 18:00; open daily.

roles: Owner (unnamed), formerly a wine importer; manager and staff
chef_bio.background: Opened 2 February 2012 (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer says the owner, with a background as an importer, chose the 160 bottles.
chef_bio.philosophy: Good wine at fair prices with grilled dishes (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner praised the manager's explanations of wine and aged cheese, but heard a young staff member answer another guest with "Please look at the blackboard."
A May 2026 couple on a date found the staff were fellow Hanshin fans and made friends.
An August 2026 diner was warned that some dishes take about an hour, so order early.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 京都ダイナー、バル・イタリアン・ワインバー、中京区柳馬場通錦小路上ル十文字町451 1F、四条駅・烏丸駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 15:00〜22:30、土日祝 12:00〜22:30、無休 (不定休あり)、要予約、付き出し380円 (税込)、18時以降は未成年不可、カード・PayPay 可、英語メニュー、36席 (カウンター15、テーブル21)、禁煙 (入口の樽席に灰皿)、2012年2月2日オープン、厳選ワイン160種、黒毛和牛のローストビーフ。口コミ (2026年5〜9月、英語): インポーター出身のオーナー、グラスワイン700円から、ローストビーフ2,800円、前菜盛り合わせ1,500円、とうもろこしのキッシュ900円、アンチョビポテト600円、チョコテリーヌ680円、熟成チーズ、ボトルで前菜盛り合わせのサービス、料理に1時間かかるものも、若いスタッフの対応への不満。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kyoto_diner_nishiki.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26019479/ (35.005410, 135.763898); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区十文字町451番地 (lot) 34m; 2026-11-06

kyoto_cafe_tiger_kamigyo.gf_detail: Not GF: the menu centres on wheat noodles (tiger noodles, dry tantan, lu rou noodles), Napolitan pasta, doria and toast (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_tiger_kamigyo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: minced-meat noodles, braised pork rice, chashu and eggs (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_tiger_kamigyo.hours_raw: Tuesday–Friday 11:00–20:00; Monday, Saturday and Sunday 11:00–16:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 18 seats incl. a counter, mixed chairs and sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog; May 2024). A morning set is served (Tabelog; January 2024). In an old house behind plants just west of Muromachi on Churaku-dori, near the Prefectural Office; 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; May 2024). Opened 27 October 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_tiger_kamigyo.notes: [Café · near the Prefectural Office, Taiwanese noodles] A plant-screened old house turned café, full of tiger decor and books: "tiger noodles" and dry tantan with minced meat and a soft egg, lu rou fan, a generous Napolitan, and a morning set, with salad and soup at lunch. Pick your spice level — level 3 of 4 is fiery. QR payment, no cards. Open daily from 11:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 27 October 2016, with breakfast. Reviewers describe a renovated private house with antique interiors among government offices and a hospital (July 2019), tiger-themed decorations, books, blankets and a small heater at the seats (January 2024), and Taiwanese dishes alongside pasta and doria (2024–2025).

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 diner overheard a neighbour ask for a smaller portion of Napolitan — and, when it arrived, understood why.
A December 2025 regular chose spice level 3 of 4 on the lu rou noodles and struggled to finish.
A May 2026 regular from a nearby office orders dry tiger noodles extra-large and spicy, then mixes in rice at the end.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、上京区東立売町211-2、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩5分、火〜金 11:00〜20:00、月・土・日 11:00〜16:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、18席、禁煙、モーニングあり、2016年10月27日オープン。口コミ (2019年7月〜2026年5月、英語): 室町中立売の西、緑に囲まれた古い民家、府庁の近く、虎の飾りと本、タイガー麺 (汁なし、冷やし、ひき肉、温泉卵、きゅうり、辛さと量を選べる)、汁なし担々麺、魯肉飯1,000円、魯肉麺、ナポリタン (大盛り)、ドリア、ランチはサラダとミニスープ付き、モーニングセット1,100円。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; choose spice level; QR, no cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through May 2026.

kyoto_cafe_tiger_kamigyo.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26028181/ (35.019874, 135.757670); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市上京区東立売町211番地 (lot) 25 m; nearest Kyoto record 157 m away; 2026-11-06

kyoto_harebare_yoshida.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and fish built on dashi and soy, with fried dishes and spring rolls at night; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_harebare_yoshida.vegan_detail: Ask. The cooking centres on organic vegetables, but dashi, fish, duck and egg run through the set and the evening dishes (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_harebare_yoshida.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday and holidays 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday and Monday; occasional closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A dinner-only charge of ¥400 per person (Tabelog original ディナーのみチャージ料としてお一人様当たり４００円（税込）). Lunch is one set only (2024–2025 reviews). 20 seats: 4 at the counter and 16 at tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Yoshida-Shimoadachi-cho, near Kojinbashi; 5 min from the Kojinbashi or Konoe-dori bus stops, 10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_harebare_yoshida.notes: [Obanzai · Yoshida near Kojinbashi, organic vegetables] A calm, stylish izakaya-café west of the Kamo River devoted to organic vegetables: at lunch a single ¥1,500 set of eight small obanzai, clay-pot rice and sake-lees soup; at night shareable plates, fresh fish and a good sake list. Portions run small, and one guest found a fish overcooked. ¥400 dinner charge. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese izakaya-café of seasonal flavours with vegetable and seafood dishes; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe plenty of organic vegetables and Kyoto produce (May 2024; January 2025), a wide sake list (May 2024), and small, carefully made portions (2024–2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal flavours, organic vegetables (Tabelog; May 2024 review).

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 business traveller from Tokyo found the vegetable set exactly what a tired body needed.
An October 2025 regular praised fried winter melon and fig-and-cheese spring rolls, but found the herb-crusted mackerel burnt and bitter.
A December 2024 diner, once no fan of carrots, came round to carrots here.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・野菜料理・魚介、左京区吉田下阿達町15、京阪神宮丸太町駅から徒歩約10分、京都バス荒神橋・近衛通から徒歩約5分、火〜土・祝 11:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)・17:30〜22:00、日・月定休 (臨時休業あり)、予約可、ディナーのみチャージ料1人400円 (税込)、20席 (カウンター4、テーブル16)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、旬を楽しむ和の居酒屋カフェ。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年1月、英語): ランチは一汁八菜1,500円の一種のみ (人参のタルタル、鴨ロース、冷たい卵焼き、山椒の昆布の佃煮など、土鍋ご飯、粕汁)、ご飯の追加150円、有機野菜、量は少なめ、夜はおばんざい3種盛り、なめろう、Usukawa-hagi などのお造り、冬瓜の揚げ物、無花果とチーズの春巻き、鰆の香草焼き (焦げていたとの声)、かぼちゃのひき肉の天ぷら、まかないカレー、日本酒が豊富、有機生姜のジンジャーエール。

cultural_comfort.note: One lunch set; ¥400 dinner charge; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through January 2026.

kyoto_harebare_yoshida.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26036365/ (35.021918, 135.775454); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市左京区吉田下阿達町15番地 (lot) 3 m; nearest Kyoto record 349 m away; 2026-11-06

kyoto_gooudo_hachijo.gf_detail: Ask. Wood-fired vegetables and meats, but sauces such as Kanazawa miso and a creamy potato salad vary; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gooudo_hachijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Grilled vegetables from the group's own farm are central, but one lotus-root dish is finished with venison fat, and many plates use meat, fish or dairy (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gooudo_hachijo.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online via the restaurant's website, and advised — full on holidays (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter around a central wood-fire kitchen, and Japanese-style private rooms upstairs; smoking allowed (Tabelog; August 2026). Courses with self-serve all-you-can-drink from the fridge in private rooms (October 2026). About 5 min walk from Kyoto Station Hachijo exit (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 13 December 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gooudo_hachijo.notes: [Wood-fire dining · Kyoto Station Hachijo side] A stylish counter around a central firewood grill, five minutes from Kyoto Station's south exit: farm-fresh vegetables and venison, skirt or ichibo cooked over the embers, with carpaccios of eel or conger eel, white-miso yuba with peach, and a good wine list; private tatami rooms upstairs. One October 2026 regular felt the menu had shrunk and some sauces grown heavy. Book ahead. Smoking allowed. Evenings, daily.

roles: Kitchen staff at the wood-fire grill (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a dining bar opened 13 December 2023 near Kyoto Station. Reviewers in 2026 describe a restaurant of a well-known Kyoto group that runs its own farm and delivers vegetables to each location (the group name is written in several ways), cooking over firewood in a central kitchen (August 2026), seen on TV (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Vegetables from the group's own farm, cooked over firewood (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 guest had wanted to come for over two years after seeing it on TV, and finally booked during Obon.
An August 2026 guest who arrived ten minutes early was asked to wait outside while earlier diners finished.
An October 2026 regular found the once-hollandaise potato salad now a soupy meat-and-potato dish, and the menu shorter than before.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー、南区東九条西山王町8-1、京都駅から303m、毎日 17:00〜23:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、個室あり、喫煙可、2023年12月13日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 八条口から徒歩5分、中央の薪の厨房を囲むカウンター、2階に和の個室、自社農園の野菜を各店に届けるグループの店、薪火で焼く野菜と肉、オクラ、アスパラ、生だこ、金沢の味噌と鹿の脂の蓮根、鹿のステーキとソーセージ、ハラミ、イチボ、和牛、鰻のカルパッチョ、鱧と白セロリのカルパッチョ1,350円、桃と生湯葉の白味噌900円、賀茂茄子とクリームチーズ、鰹と九条ねぎのソース、ポテトサラダ、ワイン、キリンラガー650円、ISOHAGAN のハイボール800円、個室は冷蔵庫から自由に飲めるコース、テレビで紹介、ネット予約、メニューが減り味が変わったとの声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; counter or private rooms; smoking allowed; cards, IC and QR.

kyoto_grill_yahei_kamishichiken.gf_detail: Not GF: breaded fried shrimp and scallops, croquettes, demi-glace sauces and pilaf omurice (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_grill_yahei_kamishichiken.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, steak, fried seafood and egg-wrapped omurice (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_grill_yahei_kamishichiken.hours_raw: Wednesday–Friday 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:30; Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday 17:30–21:30; closed Monday and the third Tuesday of the month; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); lunch can fill just after 11:30 (March 2025). Cash only (Tabelog). Counter and tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; June 2025). On a quiet street in Kamishichiken, a short walk from Kitano Tenmangu; about 700 m from Kitano-Hakubaicho Stn (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_grill_yahei_kamishichiken.notes: [Yoshoku · Kamishichiken by Kitano Tenmangu] A small, classic Western-style grill on a quiet Kamishichiken street, run by the master and the master's wife: rich corn potage, crisp fried shrimp, tender hamburg under demi-glace, and a fluffy omurice over butter pilaf, with a short wine list and an omakase course by evening. Friendly chats at the counter. Portions run modest. Cash only; closed Monday.

roles: The owner's wife, at front of house (April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yoshoku restaurant in Kamishichiken. Reviewers describe a popular, classic Western-style restaurant with regulars from nearby (March 2025), a master who serves an omakase course (July 2025), and an owner's wife who chats with guests (April 2026); an August 2026 guest talked with the owner after the meal.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 couple noticed a Mucha-collaboration coaster under the beer glass, and the owner's wife joined in to share stories.
A March 2025 guest got the last table at a lunch that filled just after 11:30.
An October 2026 diner, watching kimono-clad passers-by, found the croquettes authentic but warned that students would not leave stuffed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食、上京区真盛町706、北野白梅町駅から695m、水〜金 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜21:30、火・土・日 17:30〜21:30、月曜と第3火曜定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 上七軒、北野天満宮の近く、昔ながらの洋食店、近所の常連、ハンバーグランチ、日替わりランチ1,800円 (もち豚ロースのチーズパン粉焼き)、バターライスのオムライス (デミグラス) 1,800円 (スープとサラダ付き)、ステーキランチ、海老フライとハンバーグ、鮭フライと蟹クリームコロッケ、照り焼きチキン、マスターのおまかせ洋食コース、ワイン、コーンポタージュ、マスターと奥さん、ミュシャのコースター、量は控えめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in early for lunch; cash only; counter or tables.

kyoto_chicken_tacos_raicho_jinja.gf_detail: Ask. Tacos on homemade tortillas (corn or wheat not stated), chicken over rice with butter rice, Sri Lankan curry, fried chicken and fries (2026 reviews).
kyoto_chicken_tacos_raicho_jinja.vegan_detail: Ask. A “Kyoto vegetable original” taco is on the menu, but fillings and tortillas are not described; most dishes are chicken or pork (2026 reviews).
kyoto_chicken_tacos_raicho_jinja.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00, dinner 18:00–1:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Lunch is a set menu only, paid in advance, ordered downstairs before going up to the second floor (April–May 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 30 seats: 10 at the counter and five tables for four; the second floor can be hired for 20–30 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed on the first floor (Tabelog; August 2026). Free Wi-Fi; sports viewing (Tabelog). A small shrine inside; guests may write on ema plaques (April and October 2026). 3 min from Keihan Shichijo Stn, 7 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_chicken_tacos_raicho_jinja.notes: [Chicken and tacos · near Shichijo, a shrine inside] A cheerful, graffiti-walled chicken-and-taco bar near Keihan Shichijo with its own little shrine and ema to write on: nine kinds of tacos on homemade tortillas, chicken over rice, crisp chicken thigh with fries, and a spicy Sri Lankan curry at lunch. Open late (to 1:00); smoking allowed downstairs. Closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Invoice T1130001051904 is registered to 株式会社ＡＦＬＯ・ＸＬ (NTA register). Reviewers describe friendly staff and a homey atmosphere (2026); a January 2026 diner found the fillings mild, as if tailored for Japanese tastes, but praised the tortillas.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner was surprised to find a shrine inside the restaurant.
An October 2026 first-timer at a Mexican restaurant was allowed to write on an ema plaque.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: chicken & tacos 雷鳥神社、メキシコ料理・タコス、下京区新日吉町132-6、京阪七条駅から徒歩3分、京都駅から徒歩7分、昼12:00〜15:00、夜18:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.23:30)、水曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、30席 (カウンター10、4人卓5)、2階は貸切可、1階は喫煙可、適格請求書 T1130001051904 (株式会社ＡＦＬＯ・ＸＬ)。口コミ (2026年、英語): タコス9種 (京野菜のオリジナル、ポークのワカモレ、カルニタス、チポトレ)、自家製トルティーヤ、チキンオーバーライス (むねかもも、バターライスかトルティーヤ、ヨーグルトソース)、スリランカカレーのランチ、もも肉のフライとポテト、店内に神社と絵馬、昼は前払いでセットのみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay first at lunch; smoking allowed on the ground floor.

kyoto_brunbrun_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Chocolates, cakes (New York cheesecake, Mont Blanc, apple cake) and baked goods made upstairs, a weekday lunch, and chocolate kakigori in summer; ingredients are not described (Tabelog shop text; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_brunbrun_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Cakes and kakigori use dairy (cream cheese, condensed milk); the chocolates are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_brunbrun_marutamachi.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 10:00–17:30 (L.O. 17:00); holidays 10:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:00); closed Sunday and Monday; lunch 11:30–13:30 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats with sofas in an eat-in area behind the shop (Tabelog; July 2025). Non-smoking; strollers welcome (Tabelog; May 2025). On the corner of Higashinotoin and Takeyamachi, 2 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 5 (Tabelog). Founded 10 April 1935 (Tabelog).
kyoto_brunbrun_marutamachi.notes: [Chocolate and café · south of the Imperial Palace, since 1935] An old Kyoto chocolatier — making chocolate since before the war — with a showcase of cakes made upstairs and a quiet sofa café at the back with classical music. Locals come for a cake set or, May to September, a towering chocolate kakigori. A short lunch too. Cash only; closed Sundays and Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: established in 1935 (Showa 10) and making and selling chocolate since before the war, when chocolate was still uncommon; cakes and baked goods are made one by one in the factory on the building’s second floor. A February 2026 regular returned after years and found the same comforting flavours, with a room full of locals.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 passer-by, ducking in from the heat for shaved ice, only then learned the shop is famous for chocolate.
A May 2025 visitor wanted the Mont Blanc, found it sold out, and chose the apple cake from the showcase.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブランブリュン、チョコレート・ケーキ・喫茶店、中京区竹屋町通東洞院西入ル三本木町462、丸太町駅5番出口から東へ徒歩2分、火〜土 10:00〜17:30 (L.O.17:00)、祝日 10:00〜17:00、日・月定休、ランチ11:30〜13:30、予約不可、現金のみ、20席 (ソファ席)、禁煙、1935年4月10日創業。店の紹介: 昭和10年創業、戦前のチョコレートが珍しかった頃からチョコレートを製造販売、ケーキと焼き菓子は2階の工房でひとつずつ手作り、クラシック音楽の流れるカフェ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ケーキセット、モンブラン、りんごのケーキ、ニューヨークチーズケーキ、5〜9月のチョコレートのかき氷、地元の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick cakes from the showcase; cash only; a quiet local café.

kyoto_mamehachi_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Tofu and yuba dishes with dashi and soy, soy-milk white-miso oden, nama-fu dengaku (wheat gluten), yuba tempura and fried tofu, koji-marinated meat and fish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mamehachi_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Much of the menu is tofu, yuba and vegetables, but dashi is used (fried eggplant and yuba in dashi) and fish, chicken and sake-lees fish appear in the courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mamehachi_pontocho.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); irregular closures for maintenance days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Otoshi ¥550 per person (Tabelog, original お通し代として550円頂いております。). Cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay); no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats: counter, tables and private rooms for 4–8; parties up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Pontocho, just north of Shijo on the west side, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 1A (Tabelog).
kyoto_mamehachi_pontocho.notes: [Tofu and obanzai · Pontocho by Shijo] A small tofu restaurant at the Shijo end of Pontocho with a counter and private rooms: yuba sashimi, soy-milk white-miso oden, nama-fu dengaku, yuba tempura and obanzai, as a ¥5,500 course or lunch sets with a soy-milk hot pot. Gentle flavours that suit older guests; sake from Sasaki Shuzo. ¥550 otoshi. Staff are largely students; service can be slow when busy.

chef_bio.background: Invoice T5130002012752 is registered to 有限会社プロスパー (NTA register). Tabelog also lists 豆八 本店 and MAMEHACHI CHAYA. Reviewers note the staff were largely university students (September–October 2026) and that a young server from abroad was attentive (July 2026); a June 2026 diner found dishes came slowly but was satisfied.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner in the forties brought a mother in the seventies, who left very happy.
A May 2026 host used a private room for guests from afar, and even the older guests ate heartily.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豆腐料理とおばんざい まるたけえびす豆八 京都 先斗町、日本料理・豆腐料理・居酒屋、中京区四条通先斗町上ル西側22、阪急河原町駅1A出口から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、夜17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、不定休、予約可、お通し代550円、カード・QR可、36席 (カウンター、テーブル、個室4〜8名)、禁煙、適格請求書 T5130002012752 (有限会社プロスパー)。口コミ (2026年、英語): まるたけコース5,500円、豆乳鍋のまるたけランチ、おばんざいランチ、汲み上げ湯葉の刺身、豆腐5種、湯葉の天ぷら、二色の生麩田楽、粕漬けの焼き魚、豆乳白味噌のおでん、ちりめん山椒の茶漬け、麹漬けの鯖と鶏、佐々木酒造の酒、スタッフは大学生が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Pontocho restaurant with many overseas visitors on the street; private rooms; ¥550 otoshi.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_nikumon_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu yakiniku with table sauces and rock salt, offal, motsunabe, bibimbap, steak bowls; sauce ingredients not given (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nikumon_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu yakiniku and offal restaurant (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nikumon_kawaramachi.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30) daily; closed the second and fourth Thursdays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats including counter and sofa seating; private rooms from 2 to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, birthday plates, take-out (Tabelog). “Meat Day” specials on the 29th (October 2026). In a 100-year-old townhouse on Kawaramachi north of Takeyamachi, 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 5 March 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nikumon_kawaramachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Kawaramachi-Takeyamachi, a machiya grill] The second shop of the Shijo-Omiya yakiniku NIKUMON, in a 100-year-old townhouse on Kawaramachi: Kuroge Wagyu and Manyo beef, offal such as omasum and Omi beef hoso, yukhoe and a premium tongue, with good-value lunch bowls and bibimbap and motsunabe in the cold months. Open 11:00–23:00; meat-day specials on the 29th. About ¥5,000–8,000 at dinner.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer calls this the second branch of NIKUMON, “thriving in Shijo Omiya for 10 years”, opened in March 2024 in a 100-year-old traditional house. Another October 2026 diner found the young staff polite and efficient.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular came back nine days after a visit for the 29th “Meat Day” steak bowl and found rock salt the best match.
A September 2026 regular on an eighth visit chose the spiciness of the overflowing onsen-egg sauce at lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉もん 河原町竹屋町店、焼肉・もつ鍋・ホルモン、中京区河原町通竹屋町上ル大文字町242-3、神宮丸太町駅・京都市役所前駅から徒歩約5分、11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、第2・第4木曜休み、予約可、カード・QR可、36席、個室2〜20名、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、2024年3月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 四条大宮で10年の「肉もん」の2号店、築100年の町家、黒毛和牛と Manyo 牛、特選和牛盛り2,980円、厚切り盛り3,580円、ハラミ1,280円、白センマイ780円、特上ユッケ1,580円、近江牛ホソと辛い麺1,180円、ほそ巻き、もつ鍋、昼の和牛丼やビビンバ、29日の肉の日。

cultural_comfort.note: Family-friendly yakiniku with private rooms; lunch sets.

kyoto_izon.gf_detail: Ask: courses centre on spices, basmati rice and biryani, but include pastry-style starters, potages and desserts whose make-up is not published (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_izon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: eel, seafood fumet, salmon, lamb and dairy (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_izon.hours_raw: Official site: reservation-only courses starting together — lunch 12:00 and dinner 18:30 (Tabelog: lunch Fri–Sun, dinner Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun; closed Wednesday and irregularly). Book by the day before via TableCheck or phone; at most 4 guests per sitting, and 3 or more take the whole house; private bookings can start earlier for guests catching a late train. 4 seats at the counter and sofa; non-smoking; no perfume; children only if eating the adult course; English menu; cards, e-money and most QR (Tabelog). In a 100-year-old machiya at the end of a narrow alley (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_izon.notes: [Spice gastronomy · an alley south of the Imperial Palace, four seats] A four-seat dining room in a hundred-year-old machiya at the end of a Gosho-minami alley, cooking "innovative spice" courses that travel to a new country every few months — Denmark and Greenland, Tunisia — with Kyoto produce and signatures like eel dolma and bamboo biryani. Run by a chef and a childhood friend, per a regular. Omakase ¥16,500; lunch courses from about ¥2,500 in 2026 reviews. Book by the day before.

roles: Chef not named; "run by a chef and a childhood friend" (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a reservation-only restaurant in a 100-year-old machiya at the back of an alley south of the Imperial Palace, weaving stories from world history and culture into courses that combine Kyoto’s seasons and spices, valuing aroma over heat and keeping oil and aromatics light. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe thorough explanations of each dish, a quarterly country theme, and an earlier Indian-French fusion lunch (September 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「スパイスの刺激よりも香りを大切に、オイルや香味野菜は控えめに、体に優しく、美しいコース料理を」.

anecdotes.text: March 2026, the Denmark and Greenland theme: mashed potato and cheese shaped like an iceberg, its base dyed blue with butterfly pea, with seaweed on top "to symbolize the land exposed due to global warming."
February 2026: the usual choice of two soups was not offered that day — "That was a bit disappointing."
March 2026: the homemade chai was ordered, then "I was informed later that it wasn’t available."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (izon-kyoto.jp): izon、京都御所南、スパイス・ガストロノミー、一皿ごとに国境を越える食の世界旅行、世界の歴史や文化から物語を紡ぎ京都の旬とスパイスを掛け合わせるイノベーティブ、香りを大切に、オイルや香味野菜は控えめ、京都御所南のろうじの奥の築百年の京町家、完全予約制、セルクル仕立てのオードブル (インドの6つの味)、鰻のドルマ、バンブービリヤニ (大原野菜、バスマティライス)、イノベーティブ・スパイスのおまかせコース16,500円、昼12:00・夜18:30一斉スタート、各回最大4名 (3名以上で一棟貸切)、前日までに予約、不定休。食べログ: イノベーティブ、中京区毘沙門町556-1、4席、香水は控えて、子供は大人と同じ料理を食べる場合のみ、英語メニュー、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): シェフと幼なじみで営む、季節ごとに国のテーマ (デンマークとグリーンランド、チュニジア、次はモロッコ)、カジュアルコース2,480円、スタンダード3,580円とペアリング2,100円、大原の野菜のサラダ、スパイスのポタージュ、グラブラックス、ラム、カルダモンとナッツのアイステリーヌ、氷山の形のポテトとチーズ、料理の説明が丁寧、スープの選択がなかった・チャイがなかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and site; dishes explained in detail.

kyoto_rojioku_garden168.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: hamburg steak, burgers, shepherd’s pie, fried chicken and bread sides (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rojioku_garden168.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature is a six-egg dashimaki; other mains are chicken, lamb, pork and beef (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rojioku_garden168.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 11:30–15:00 (Mon, Wed–Sun); dinner 18:00–23:00 Wed, Thu, Sun and holidays, to midnight Fri and Sat; Monday is lunch only, and Tuesday is the day off. Lunch seats 1.5 hours; parties of three or more book by phone; the whole party must arrive together, bookings lapse after 10 minutes, and same-day cancellations cost ¥1,000 a person. Dinner from 18:00: one drink and one food per person to start, no one under 20. 12 seats; no smoking inside, smoking in the courtyard and on the terrace. No service charge or cover — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料・チャージ料 無し」. Cards and PayPay. Opened 16 March 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rojioku_garden168.notes: [Café & bar · Ogawa-Oike, at the end of a stone alley] A twelve-seat café-bar down a stone alley in a 300-year-old townhouse of craft workshops near Nijo Castle: ¥1,600 lunches of a six-egg dashimaki, hamburg steak or the limited daily plate with obanzai and pickles, and cocktails at night. Book ahead — it fills within minutes of opening. Tight aisles; ¥1,000 same-day cancellation fee. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 16 March 2017 (Tabelog), at the back of an alley in the Marumasu Nishimura-ya building on Ogawa-dori. Reviewers in 2026 describe a historic townhouse said to be over 300 years old, home to a dyeing workshop and leather workshop, a small room of four two-seat tables and one four-seat table, and lunches that fill up soon after 11:30.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "After placing my order, I overheard another table mentioning that the dashimaki is made with six large eggs… Six eggs!?"
November 2026: "The atmosphere isn’t particularly relaxing, but the food is delicious!" — and the narrow path to the back table was hard with large bags.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 路地奥Garden168、カフェ・バー、中京区小川通御池南下ル壺屋町 丸益西村屋 路地奥、二条城前駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (月・水〜日)、夜18:00〜23:00 (水木日祝)・〜24:00 (金土)、月曜夜と火曜休み、昼は1時間半制、3名以上は電話予約、全員揃って来店、10分過ぎると自動キャンセル、当日キャンセルは1人1,000円、夜は最初にワンドリンク・ワンフード、20歳未満不可、12席、店内禁煙 (中庭とテラスで喫煙可)、サービス料・チャージ料 無し、カード・PayPay可、2017年3月16日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): 築300年以上の町家、染色や革の工房、ランチはすべて1,600円 (飲み物別)、卵6個のだし巻き定食と大根おろし、数量限定のガーデンランチ (梅しその鶏むね唐揚げ、生姜焼き、鶏の煮物)、ハンバーグ、特製牛100%ハンバーガー、ラムのシェパーズパイ、サラダ、おばんざい3種、漬物3種、具だくさんの味噌汁、ご飯かパン、すぐ満席、通路が狭い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; the entrance is down a stone alley with a small lantern sign.

kyoto_kyogoku_kaneyo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: eel glazed in a soy-based tare, served over rice (official site; reviews).
kyoto_kyogoku_kaneyo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: eel, egg, liver soup, carp (reviews).
kyoto_kyogoku_kaneyo.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesday (monthly closures on the official site); may close in typhoons; phone after 14:00. Foreign-booking policy (Tabelog, English auto-translation): "For inbound customers, please make reservations for seats only through our website, rather than for course meals." Cancellation policy (official site): sets and courses 100% on the day, 50% the day before; seat-only bookings ¥3,000 a person on the day. Unannounced lateness over 30 minutes counts as a cancellation. 40 seats — tables downstairs, tatami upstairs (where families with small children are seated; no children’s chairs); non-smoking; cards and PayPay; take-out and delivery.
kyoto_kyogoku_kaneyo.notes: [Unagi · Rokkaku-Shinkyogoku, a Meiji-era eel house] A Meiji-founded eel restaurant off Shinkyogoku with a Taisho-era interior, famous for its kinshi-don — eel over rice buried under a dashimaki that overflows the bowl (¥3,000). Listed in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka 2026; rakugo nights upstairs each month. Overseas guests are asked to book seats only, through its website. Strict cancellation fees. Some find the egg overwhelms the eel. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in the Meiji era, an eel specialist whose craftsmen grill Shizuoka and Kyushu eel Edo-style with a secret tare topped up since the founding; the kinshi-don with Kyoto-style dashimaki is the favourite; the retro interior is unchanged since the Taisho era, and the upstairs tatami room hosts a monthly rakugo night (かねよ寄席). It notes selection for the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka 2026, ten straight years in the Michelin Guide, a 2024 Trip.Gourmet award, and a JAPAN FOOD SELECTION gold for its kabayaki.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「100年続く変わらぬ味を守り続けてまいる」 — keeping a taste unchanged for a hundred years.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "The egg was so large that it overflowed from the bowl, and its firm texture made it quite satisfying. However, this meant that the flavor of the eel was somewhat overshadowed."
A family regular, October 2026: "They are also very child-friendly, and we received origami souvenirs as a gift."
A diner who had passed it since primary school on the way to a nearby cemetery finally ate there in October 2026, over carp sashimi, grilled liver and beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyogoku-kaneyo.co.jp): 日本一の鰻・京極かねよ、創業明治の老舗のうなぎ料理専門店、静岡と九州産のうなぎ、創業からつぎ足しの秘伝のタレ、きんし丼 (京風だし巻きのせ) が人気、大正時代から変わらないレトロな店内、2階座敷で毎月落語の「かねよ寄席」、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2026に選出、ミシュランに10年連続掲載、2024年 Trip.Gourmet アワード、鰻蒲焼き (上) が JAPAN FOOD SELECTION 金賞、江戸流 (背開き、白焼き、蒸してタレで本焼き)、キャンセルポリシー (セット・コース 当日100%・前日50%、席のみ予約 当日1名3,000円)、英語・中国語の予約ページ。食べログ: うなぎ・丼・どじょう、中京区六角通新京極東入ル松ヶ枝町456、京都市役所前駅から徒歩7分、11:30〜15:30 (L.O. 15:00)・17:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:00)、水曜休み、電話は14時以降、40席 (1階テーブル、2階座敷)、子供用の椅子なし (子連れは2階座敷へ)、海外からの客は公式サイトから席のみの予約を、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、テイクアウト・デリバリー。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): きんし丼 並3,000円、玉子が丼からあふれる、肝吸い、玉子のお吸い物450円、鰻入りの茶碗蒸し、肝焼き、鯉の洗い、家族連れに親切で折り紙のお土産、玉子で鰻の味が負けるという声、雨でも行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Policy for overseas guests: "please make reservations for seats only through our website, rather than for course meals" (Tabelog, English auto-translation). English and Chinese booking pages and menus on the official site.

kyoto_gontaro_shijo_honten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon and blended soba, tempura, and a soy-and-dashi broth (official site; reviews).
kyoto_gontaro_shijo_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is kombu and bonito (official site); udon-suki has chicken, shrimp and clams.
kyoto_gontaro_shijo_honten.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday, with occasional changes posted on the official site. Reservations only for the Gontaro nabe (udon-suki) courses, not seats only. 110 seats over several floors — tables on the ground floor, sunken kotatsu on the 2nd, banquet rooms above, a tea room on the 4th; private rooms for 10–48; non-smoking; English and picture menus; children welcome; cards, e-money and most QR. Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Prices revised in September 2026 (official site). Opened 14 December 1960 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gontaro_shijo_honten.notes: [Udon & soba · Shijo-Fuyacho by Nishiki Market, since 1960] The main shop of Kyoto’s Gontaro, a five-storey sukiya-style house beside Nishiki Market, serving udon and soba in its "golden" morning dashi — keiran udon, nabeyaki, zaru soba from ¥1,000 — and the Gontaro nabe udon-suki for groups (the only thing you can book). One of three Gontaro shops with Okazaki and Kinkakuji. One diner found the dashi under the grated daikon weak (September 2026). Closed Wednesday.

roles: Run by 株式会社権太呂 (president 藤本和洋, official site)
chef_bio.background: Opened 14 December 1960 (Tabelog). Per the official site: Gontaro runs three shops in Kyoto — this Shijo main shop, Okazaki and Kinkakuji — plus mail order; the main shop next to Nishiki Market is a modern five-storey building with a full sukiya-style interior; the "golden" dashi starts each morning with water and kombu, then bonito flakes. The site carries a monthly blog by the president, 藤本和洋.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「味は心 料理は心の表現」 — flavour is heart; cooking shows the cook’s heart.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: a la carte prices "a bit on the higher side," and the dashi under the grated daikon "tasted weak."
October 2026: the nabeyaki udon at ¥2,000 "may seem pricey," but "I found it completely justified after tasting it."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gontaro.co.jp): 株式会社権太呂、京都市内に3店舗 (四条本店、岡崎店、金閣寺店) と通信販売、本店は錦市場のすぐ隣で地上5階・地下1階の近代建築ながら内装は本格的な数寄屋づくり、「黄金の一汁」(早朝から水と昆布、削り節)、味は心、社長 藤本和洋のブログ、2026年9月に全店価格改定。食べログ: うどんすき・そば・うどん、中京区麸屋町通四条上ル桝屋町521、11:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜休み、予約は権太呂なべのみ、110席、個室10〜48名、禁煙、英語・写真付きメニュー、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料は原文で「なし」、1960年12月14日オープン。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): けいらんうどん1,300円、鍋焼きうどん2,000円、ざるそば1,000円、田舎そばのおろし1,000円、おろし天ぷら1,850円、天ぷらそば御膳 (そば豆腐、かやくご飯)、小芋の唐揚げ700円、そば味噌豆腐400円、権太呂なべのコース (蛤、鶏、野菜、海老、うどん)、1階テーブル・2階掘りごたつ・3〜4階宴会、4階に茶室、卓上に原了郭の黒七味、アラカルトはやや高め、おろしで出汁が薄く感じたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English and picture menus (Tabelog).

kyoto_new_taiho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles and mazesoba, gyoza (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_new_taiho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tonkotsu-shoyu broth with back fat, chashu, beef tendon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_new_taiho.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 daily (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Quick at lunch — about 15 minutes in and out (July 2026). 134 m from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_new_taiho.notes: [Ramen · Gojo Karasuma, all day from 11 to 11] A neighbourhood ramen shop open straight through: back-fat tonkotsu-shoyu with thin straight noodles, the spicy red Taiho ramen in three heats, a yuzu shio ramen, beef tendon ramen and mazesoba, with gyoza and rice sets. Quick at lunch, busy with overseas visitors at night. PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a ramen, abura-soba and mazesoba shop opened 7 July 2020. A July 2026 reviewer thought it once traded under another name. Ramen block not given: the sources do not cover all six ramen dimensions.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 lunchtime regular avoids the spicy bowls at work for fear of sweating off foundation, and finds the regular ramen balanced rather than heavy.

A November 2026 visitor during Kyoto’s modern architecture festival ordered the spicy Taiho ramen with firm noodles, extra green onions and a chashu rice ball, and was charmed by the cheerful young woman serving.
An October 2026 regular came back for the chashu ramen and found it still full of overseas visitors.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン・油そば・まぜそば、下京区大坂町404、五条駅から134m、11:00〜23:00、無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可・PayPay 可、禁煙、2020年7月7日オープン。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年11月、英語): 背脂の豚骨醤油、細いストレート麺 (硬さを選べる)、薄いチャーシュー、ねぎ、辛い大宝ラーメン (控えめ・少し辛い・辛い)、柚子の塩ラーメン、チャーシュー麺、牛すじラーメン、まぜそば、餃子、チャーシューおにぎり、外国人の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; choose spice level and noodle firmness. Many overseas visitors (October 2026). No English evidence found.

kyoto_ebisugawa_sushi_suzuka.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae omakase with red-vinegar rice, marinated and soy-brushed fish, anago with sauce and a kanpyo roll (2024–25 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_ebisugawa_sushi_suzuka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish omakase with chawanmushi, a soup and red miso soup (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_ebisugawa_sushi_suzuka.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a booking two weeks ahead is wise, though Friday seats were free in March 2024 (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). Cards accepted (Tabelog). Omakase only — Tabelog lists a fixed course at ¥12,000 before tax from February 2019; reviewers paid about ¥17,000 (December 2023) and ¥20,000–29,999 (2025–26). 8 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor of FORUM夷川 on Ebisugawa, among furniture shops; 7 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; December 2023). Opened 29 November 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ebisugawa_sushi_suzuka.notes: [Edomae sushi · Ebisugawa, a couple’s eight-seat counter] A brass door among Ebisugawa’s furniture shops opens on a calm counter where a chef trained in the Kanto region serves aged, red-vinegar Edomae nigiri — kinmedai, nodoguro, aged tuna, swordtip squid — with warm hospitality from the chef and the proprietress. One omakase in the evening, about ¥17,000–25,000.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), trained in the Kanto region (September 2017); runs the shop with the proprietress (2023–25 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Edomae sushi counter opened 29 November 2016. A September 2017 review says the head chef trained in the Kanto region and sourced fish from Tsukiji; a May 2025 review calls it Edomae sushi by a chef who came back to Kyoto from Tsukiji, run by a couple.

anecdotes.text: A December 2023 diner found the brass door intimidating but the room calm, with glass as well as ceramic tableware.
An August 2024 regular wrote of the thick-cut tuna, a shima-aji with a secret, and squid cut and salted just so.
A July 2023 diner felt the gentle flow of the sushi reflected the personalities of the chef and the proprietress.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区俵屋町305 FORUM夷川 1F、丸太町駅から徒歩約7分、17:30〜22:00、不定休、予約可、カード可、カウンター8席、禁煙、おまかせ12,000円 (税別、2019年2月から)、2016年11月29日オープン。口コミ (2017年9月〜2026年5月、英語): 関東で修業した大将 (築地から京都へ)、夫婦で営む、赤酢のシャリ、熟成した魚、金目鯛、のどぐろ、まぐろ、剣先いか、小肌、うに、穴子、新子、梅の茶碗蒸し、蓮根饅頭、ほうじ茶プリン、握り約10貫と赤だし、約17,000円 (2023年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; one omakase at the counter, extra pieces on request. No English evidence found.

kyoto_tenkuu_tachinomi_tosaka.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese, Western and Chinese plates — fries, shrimp mayo, mapo tofu, carpaccio, sashimi (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_tenkuu_tachinomi_tosaka.vegan_detail: Ask. Some vegetable dishes — mizunasu eggplant, mushroom carpaccio (with cheese), fresh yuba — but most plates use meat or fish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tenkuu_tachinomi_tosaka.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 15:00–23:00; Wed 17:00–22:00; Sat–Sun 13:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」; Tabelog’s English wrongly says one is added). Cards only for bills of ¥5,000 or more; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 36 places, standing (Tabelog). Non-smoking with a smoking area (Tabelog). The menu is limited early in the day until the manager arrives (August 2026). 4th floor of a building on Muromachi south of Kizuyabashi, by Kyoto Stn’s Karasuma exit; 3 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_tenkuu_tachinomi_tosaka.notes: [Standing bar · Kyoto Stn north, a fourth-floor counter with big windows] A hard-to-find standing bar a few minutes from the Karasuma exit, cooking well above standing-bar level — fresh yuba, mushroom carpaccio, shrimp mayo, Sichuan mapo tofu, seasonal specials — with beer, sake and highballs. Good for a drink before the Shinkansen. Cards only over ¥5,000.

roles: Owner/manager (unnamed) who cooks the full menu (August–September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (shop text): a standing bar on the 4th floor of a building almost connected to Kyoto Station, serving authentic Western dishes, sashimi and Japanese dishes, and Sichuan mapo tofu and Chinese dishes. An August 2026 review notes the menu is limited until the manager arrives.
chef_bio.philosophy: Familiar ingredients prepared in ways you have not tried (Tabelog, shop text).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor before a Shinkansen found one young man running the place alone and handling everything well.
A September 2026 visitor was warmly welcomed by the owner and noticed drinks and dishes timed to go together.
An August 2026 visitor came early, when only a short menu is served before the manager arrives, and found it average for the price.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ち飲み、下京区室町通木津屋橋下ル東塩小路町579-24 4F、京都駅から徒歩約3分、月火木金15:00〜23:00、水17:00〜22:00、土日13:00〜23:00、予約可、サービス料なし、カードは5,000円以上、立ち飲み36名、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)。店の紹介 (英訳): 本格的な洋食、刺身などの和食、四川の麻婆豆腐などの中華。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 生湯葉、水茄子、きのこのカルパッチョ、海老マヨ、あさりのサラダ、フライドポテト、チャンジャ、季節のおすすめ、ちょい飲みセット、中瓶580円、ウーロン茶400円、店長が来るまでは限られたメニュー、大きな窓。

cultural_comfort.note: Stand at the counter or tables and order from the menu and the daily board; cards only over ¥5,000. No English evidence found.

kyoto_de_frites_staan.gf_detail: Ask. Thick-cut Belgian fries, double-fried to order (August 2026), with house mayonnaise dips; the frying oil and any shared fryer are not stated.
kyoto_de_frites_staan.vegan_detail: Ask. Fries with house mayonnaise sauces, cheese and truffle toppings (2026 reviews); the frying fat is not stated.
kyoto_de_frites_staan.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00; closing days vary (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a queue at busy times, shorter for take-away (September and October 2026). CASHLESS — cash is not accepted; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; August–November 2026). Eating in requires one drink per person (July–November 2026). A few counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). On Shinkyogoku; 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 10 September 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_de_frites_staan.notes: [Belgian fries · Shinkyogoku, fries and a beer] A narrow Belgian frites bar off Shinkyogoku: thick skin-on fries double-fried to order (single ¥1,155) with house mayonnaise dips — Andalouse, alioli, truffle — and Gouda on top, with Stella Artois. A small serving is plenty for two. One drink each to eat in; cashless only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a beer bar opened 10 September 2023; Tabelog also lists DE FRITES STAAN HARAJUKU in Tokyo.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor found the regular size generous and the tomato mayonnaise sharp and clearly homemade.
An October 2026 visitor came back for the fluffy potatoes, arriving five minutes before opening to be first in line.
A September 2026 visitor found the fries average and the alioli just okay.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビアバー、中京区中之町542-2、京都河原町駅から徒歩3分、平日11:30〜22:00、土日祝11:00〜22:00、不定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、2023年9月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): ベルギーのフリット、皮付きの太切りを二度揚げ、クラシックフリット シングル1,155円、アンダルーズ (自家製マヨとトマト)、アリオリ、トリュフマヨ、ゴーダチーズ330円、イートインは1ドリンク制、現金不可、少ない量でも2人分、ステラ・アルトワ、コーヒーはない。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter: size, dip and toppings; cashless; one drink each to eat in. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_tous_les_deux.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a French patisserie of tarts, cakes, brownies and baked goods (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_tous_les_deux.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter, cream and eggs throughout (reviews).
kyoto_tous_les_deux.hours_raw: Shop 11:00–20:00 (Saturday, Sunday and holidays to 19:30), closing days shown on the official calendar (official site). Tabelog lists the upstairs café 11:00–17:00 on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday and closed Wednesday. A "sweets course" runs on set days in two sittings, 13:00 and 15:00, eight guests each; in 2026 it ends with November and resumes in January (official site; Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 18 seats; non-smoking; takeout and birthday cakes to order (Tabelog). At the corner of Sanjo and Shinmachi, 3 min from exit 6 of Karasuma-Oike Stn (official site).
kyoto_tous_les_deux.notes: [Sweets · Sanjo-Shinmachi, a pastry chef's shop and café] A long-running French cake shop on a corner of Sanjo-dori, with a café upstairs, where Chef Tsutsui — trained at patisseries abroad and in Kyoto hotels — makes additive-free tarts, cakes and chocolates. On set days a 'sweets course' wheels small cakes to just eight guests per sitting. Takarazuka photos on the walls. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: handmade cakes by Chef Tsutsui, who trained at renowned patisseries overseas and at Kyoto hotels, with cakes, chocolates and baked goods free of additives; a second-floor café with a weekend sweets service from a cart, and birthday cakes to order. The official site (Tous Les Deux) lists the shop’s hours and the sweets-course dates.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: carefully made sweets without additives.
chef_bio.specialty: Cake course from the cart; fruit tarts.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 guest found the sweets course like being invited to a party, with eight groups per sitting.
A March 2026 visitor noticed photos of the Takarazuka Revue all over the interior.
A July 2026 visitor came on Gion Festival Yoiyama for the Yamaboko parfait missed the year before.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (nau-now.com): 京都のフランス菓子ショップ トゥレ・ドゥー (Tous Les Deux)、中京区三条通新町角、地下鉄御池駅6番出口から徒歩3分、11:00〜20:00 (土日祝11:00〜19:30)、休みはカレンダーで、極上スイートコースは指定日に1部13:00・2部15:00、各8名、年内は11月で終了し1月から再開。食べログ: カフェ・ケーキ・チョコレート、中京区三条通新町角町頭町112 1F・2F、カフェは月火木金11:00〜17:00、土日はケーキビュッフェ2部制、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー不可、18席、禁煙、テイクアウト。公式紹介: 海外の有名パティスリーと京都のホテルで修業した Tsutsui シェフの無添加のケーキ、チョコレート、焼き菓子、2階のカフェ、誕生日ケーキ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): いちごのタルト680円、くるみのブラウニー、祇園祭の山鉾パフェ、宝塚の写真。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; book the sweets course ahead.

existence.note: Official site with a November 2026 calendar and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_yakitori_aogu.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori with salt or tare, fried wings, and nyumen; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_yakitori_aogu.hours_raw: 18:00–01:00 (last order 24:00); closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter and 6 in private rooms; smoking allowed per Tabelog; VISA and PayPay (Tabelog). On the west side of Kawaramachi-dori just north of Ebisugawa, 457 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; July 2024). Opened 31 October 2021 as a yakitori-and-soba collaboration; reviewers say the soba chef left in March 2024 and soba is no longer served (June 2024).
kyoto_yakitori_aogu.notes: [Yakitori · Kawaramachi-Ebisugawa, binchotan skewers till 1 a.m.] A small counter and two private rooms on Kawaramachi north of Ebisugawa, grilling Kyo-akaji chicken over Kishu binchotan into the small hours. Skewers run about ¥180–280 — don't miss the overnight-dried crispy wings — and the side dishes are as good as the skewers. Finish with Handa nyumen or egg on rice. Book ahead; smoking allowed. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 31 October 2021 as a yakitori-and-soba restaurant, a collaboration between a soba cook from a soba-restaurant family and a yakitori chef. A June 2024 reviewer reports the soba chef left in March 2024 and soba was dropped; it continues as a yakitori counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo-akaji yakitori over binchotan; crispy dried wings.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor recommends the overnight-dried crispy chicken wings above all.
A May 2026 diner finished with rice, raw egg and mustard-dressed cartilage.
A December 2024 regular comes back about every three months.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼鳥 仰、居酒屋・焼き鳥、中京区河原町通夷川上ル指物町322、神宮丸太町駅から457m、18:00〜翌1:00 (L.O. 24:00)、木曜定休、14席 (カウンター8、個室6)、喫煙可、VISA・PayPay 可、2021年10月31日オープン、そば屋の家の蕎麦職人と焼鳥職人のコラボの焼鳥とそばの店。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 2024年3月に蕎麦職人が抜けそばは終了、紀州備長炭の京赤地鶏、串180〜280円 (もも、ねぎま、せせり、やげん軟骨、つくね、背肝、ささみ、一夜干しの手羽、うずら、厚揚げ)、ユッケ780円、わさび菜のおひたし400円、ひね鶏と蓮根の酢味噌550円、ピリ辛軟骨700円、鶏そぼろのポテトサラダ550円、半田にゅうめん850円、卵かけご飯。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; book ahead; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_sekki_six_senses.gf_detail: Some options: the restaurant offers a gluten-free afternoon tea (Tabelog official introduction; August 2026 review). Other dishes are not marked; ask about cross-contact.
kyoto_sekki_six_senses.vegan_detail: Ask. A plant-based dinner course was served to a vegan guest in September 2026; the regular menus use fish and meat (reviews).
kyoto_sekki_six_senses.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:30; lunch 12:00–14:30 (Sunday brunch 12:00–14:30); afternoon tea 12:00–17:30 Monday–Saturday and 15:00–17:30 Sunday; dinner 18:00–21:30 (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料金 15％」). 52 seats including sofas and an open terrace facing a garden; a private room for 8 (¥6,000 for 2 hours); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On basement level 2 of Six Senses Kyoto, near Sanjusangendo, 599 m from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 23 April 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sekki_six_senses.notes: [Hotel dining · Higashiyama-Shichijo, Six Senses' solar-term kitchen] The all-day restaurant of Six Senses Kyoto, two floors down yet opening onto a bright garden. The menu follows the 24 solar terms with local vegetables, sustainable fish and house ferments, changing every fortnight. The afternoon tea is gluten-free and refined-sugar-free; a plant-based dinner course has been served on request. 15% service. Near Sanjusangendo.

roles: Hotel restaurant of Six Senses Kyoto; chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: contemporary cuisine inspired by the 24 solar terms of the traditional calendar, with fresh local vegetables and sustainable seafood presented in a modern style rooted in Japanese food culture; homemade fermented ingredients and a gluten-free afternoon tea designed with guest wellness in mind; the menu changes about every two weeks. Opened 23 April 2024 (Tabelog). The hotel’s Cafe Sekki is a separate listing.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: guest wellness and the blessings of each season.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner with a vegan friend chose the plant-based course and found the herbs and spices excellent.
An August 2026 guest appreciated that the seasonal afternoon tea was gluten-free and free of refined sugar.
A July 2026 family found some dishes, such as the meat sauce, too grown-up for a five-year-old.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Sekki (シックスセンシズ京都)、創作料理、東山区妙法院前側町431 シックスセンシズ京都 B2F、七条駅から599m、朝食7:00〜10:30、ランチ12:00〜14:30 (日曜はブランチ)、アフタヌーンティー12:00〜17:30 (日曜15:00〜17:30)、ディナー18:00〜21:30、サービス料15%、52席、個室 (8名、2時間6,000円)、禁煙、車椅子可、カード可、2024年4月23日オープン。公式紹介: 二十四節気から着想した現代的な料理、地元の野菜と持続可能な魚介、自家製の発酵食材、グルテンフリーのアフタヌーンティー、約2週間ごとにメニューが変わる。口コミ (2026年、英語): 庭に面した明るい空間、ケーキとドリンクのセット2,600円、シャインマスカットのアフタヌーンティー、プラントベースのコース、ビュッフェ。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel; 15% service.

gf_cross_contamination.text: No source describes how the gluten-free afternoon tea is kept apart from wheat in the kitchen, and the other menus are not marked gluten-free.

positives.text: The restaurant’s own introduction says the afternoon tea is gluten-free.
An August 2026 guest confirmed the seasonal afternoon tea was gluten-free and free of refined sugar.

existence.note: Hotel website and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kawa_coffee.gf_detail: Ask: coffee is fine; the food is a castella, toast and an ice sandwich (2021–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawa_coffee.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee and tea are plant-based; the castella comes with butter (2021 review).
kyoto_kawa_coffee.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Fri 8:00–16:30; Thu, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–16:30; closed Wednesday; latest hours on Google Maps. Smoking allowed on the ground floor, so no entry for under-20s (Tabelog); a non-smoking tatami room upstairs looks onto the Imperial Palace trees (2020–2021 reviews). One-hour limit and no laptops (June 2022). 6 seats; take-out; cash only. No espresso and no food menu beyond the castella and toast (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kawa_coffee.notes: [Coffee · Marutamachi facing the Imperial Palace, a leather-maker’s coffee house] A six-seat coffee house on Marutamachi opposite the Imperial Palace trees, run by a leather craftsman per a 2020 visitor: hand-brewed roasts and aged coffee, and a hot, fluffy "Kawa castella." Smoking downstairs (so no under-20s), a non-smoking tatami room upstairs. One-hour limit, no laptops, cash only. Closed Wednesday.

roles: The master, not named; a leather craftsman whose handmade work is shown upstairs (August 2020)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2026 describe a small two-floor coffee house beside the soba shop Hanamomo on Marutamachi: smokers downstairs, a non-smoking tatami room and gallery of the owner’s handmade leather goods upstairs, with a view of the Imperial Palace greenery. An October 2026 visitor enjoyed talking with the master during the careful brewing.

anecdotes.text: March 2023: waiting two minutes for a take-away castella in the cold, "even though there was no one in the store, I was asked to wait outside."
"I was surprised by how fruity and sweet the aroma of the aged coffee was!" — January 2025.
October 2026: "The master brewed it with great care and attention. During that time, we engaged in various conversations."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: kawa COFFEE (カワコーヒー)、喫茶店・カフェ、中京区丸太町通麩屋町西入昆布屋町397、月火金 8:00〜16:30、木土日祝 11:00〜16:30、水曜休み、最新は Google マップで、6席、喫煙可のため20歳未満は入店不可、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、フードメニューとエスプレッソはなし。口コミ (2020〜2026年、英語): 手打ちそば花桃の隣、1階は喫煙・2階は禁煙の座敷で御所の緑が見える、2階に店主の手作りの革製品、店主は革職人、中煎りモカ690円、リッチブレンド500円、深煎りのエチオピアモカ、熟成珈琲、珈琲ソーダ、カワカステラ (温かくパンケーキのよう、バター)、トーストランチ1,200円、アイスサンド、1時間制でパソコン作業不可、寒い中外で待たされたという声、マスターとの会話。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking downstairs; one-hour limit; no laptops; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog reviews dated January 2025 and October 2026.

kyoto_aotake_shichijo.gf_detail: Ask: tea and tofu shiratama (rice-flour dumplings) may suit, but chiffon and pound cakes are served too (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_aotake_shichijo.vegan_detail: Ask: tea and agar jellies may be plant-based; cakes and the vanilla ice cream are not (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_aotake_shichijo.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu, Fri 11:00–16:30 (last order 16:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–17:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; seasonal breaks announced (e.g. 10 June to early July). Reservations by phone. No preschool children, to keep the room quiet (Tabelog). 6 chair seats downstairs and a tatami room for 10 upstairs; non-smoking; cash or PayPay only.
kyoto_aotake_shichijo.notes: [Tea café · Shichijo-Takakura near Kyoto Station, a quiet machiya] A quiet tea room in a Taisho machiya ten minutes from Kyoto Station: a pot of Wazuka kabusecha or hojicha with hot water for three or more brews (the first poured by the owner), with tofu shiratama or yuzu-honey agar, looking onto a tiny courtyard. No young children. One diner found the staff tense (November 2025); another noted mosquito coils and hard chairs. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner, not named; pours the first cup (May 2026)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe an easily missed old house on Takakura near Shichijo, a Taisho-era machiya with old wooden floors and hanging scrolls, one table for four and one for two downstairs, a tatami room upstairs, a courtyard, homemade tea sweets, and a strong focus on brewing each tea well.

anecdotes.text: "The space is quite small, and the staff’s tense demeanor made me feel a bit uneasy" — and no matcha (November 2025).
April 2026: "the prices on the menu might make you think, 'Is this for just one cup?' But they provide a teapot and hot water… about 4 or 5 cups in total."
May 2026: mosquito repellent burning at the entrance, "so there were definitely some bugs around," and an average hojicha pound cake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: aotake、カフェ・甘味、下京区七条通高倉材木町485、JR京都駅・京阪七条駅から徒歩8分、月木金 11:00〜16:30 (L.O. 16:00)、土日祝 11:00〜17:00、火水休み、6月10日〜7月上旬は休業など、予約可、未就学児は入店不可、1階椅子席6・2階座敷10、禁煙、現金かPayPayのみ。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 大正時代の町家、坪庭、急須とお湯で何煎も、和束のかぶせ茶1,400円、ほうじ茶、煎茶、雁ヶ音、和紅茶、中国茶、豆腐白玉3種400円、柚子蜂蜜の寒天と海洋深層水のバニラアイス (雁ヶ音付き1,600円)、シフォンケーキ、ほうじ茶のパウンドケーキ、一煎目は店主が淹れる、店が狭くスタッフが緊張気味・抹茶がないという声、入口の蚊取り線香と虫、椅子が硬い。

cultural_comfort.note: Quiet room; no preschool children; shoes off upstairs.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_souden_temari.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura comes with the sets, and the shop says it cannot adjust dishes for allergies (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_souden_temari.vegan_detail: Not vegan: temari sushi of fish and roe, chawanmushi, wagyu at dinner (reviews); no individual requests (Tabelog).
kyoto_souden_temari.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:00) Mon and Wed–Sun; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) Wed–Sun; closed Tuesday (and Monday dinner), open on holidays. Reservations: parties over five by phone; changes and cancellations by 16:00 the day before; at least one set per person (preschool children excepted); no individual requests for allergies or dislikes. 30 seats at the counter and tables, a small garden; non-smoking; cards and PayPay; children welcome with notice. Bento to take away (official site). Opened 3 April 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_souden_temari.notes: [Temari sushi & tea · Shinmachi-Sanjo, a counter by a small garden] A calm, stylish room with a hearth and a garden where water runs over rock, serving trays of jewel-like temari sushi — each piece its own topping and sauce — with Japanese tea tastings, and a temari kaiseki at night. Lunch around ¥4,800. Some find it more about looks than flavour: one diner thought the sushi pre-made (October 2026). No allergy adjustments. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named; operated by 有限会社ミレニアムテクノロジーインク (NTA invoice register for Tabelog’s number T3120002028537)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 April 2018 (Tabelog). The official site presents temari sushi and Japanese tea at Shinmachi-Sanjo in four languages, with bento of the same temari to take home. Reviewers in 2026 describe roomy tables and counter, a small garden with spring water, a hearth where tea is prepared, and attentive staff who checked when a diner slowed down (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Temari sushi set; Japanese tea tasting.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: the sushi came within two minutes and "it seemed like the sushi had been pre-made, so it lacked freshness and felt more focused on presentation than flavor."
September 2026: a dozen inventive pieces, but "I felt a bit of palate fatigue towards the end" — and the staff asked kindly whether something was wrong when the diner slowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (souden-kyoto.jp): 手鞠鮨と日本茶 宗田、京都・新町三条、昼の部・夜の部、お弁当 (宗田の手鞠鮨を持ち帰りで)、日本語・英語・繁体字・簡体字、食材が多いので個別の対応は不可。食べログ: 寿司、中京区町頭町110-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約6分、昼11:00〜16:00 (L.O. 15:00) 月・水〜日、夜18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30) 水〜日、火曜休み (月曜は夜休み)、祝日は営業、6名以上は電話予約、変更・キャンセルは前日16時まで、1人1セット以上、アレルギー・苦手な食材の個別対応不可、30席、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、2018年4月3日オープン、インボイスは有限会社ミレニアムテクノロジーインク。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 平日限定の円満十三手鞠、天ぷらと茶碗蒸し付きのランチ4,800円 (パフェ+300円)、日本茶の飲み比べ (玉露、雁ヶ音)、夜の花篝会席 (燻製の刺身、鰹カツ、ぐじの松笠揚げ、和牛と紅茶味噌の炭火焼き、海老とキャビア・いくら・卵とトリュフの手鞠)、鯛と鯛の子、しめ鯖、帆立と黒オリーブとバジルチーズ、鰤と味噌、庭と湧き水、囲炉裏、作り置きのようで新鮮さに欠けるという声、終盤に味が重なり疲れるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Official site in English and Chinese; online booking.

existence.note: Official site live; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_mimasuya_okudohan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, spring rolls and soy-seasoned obanzai (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mimasuya_okudohan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai, fish, meat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mimasuya_okudohan.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Monday. Same-day phone bookings and Tabelog online booking (2026 reviews). 50 seats — 20 downstairs incl. a counter by the open kitchen, 30 upstairs, private rooms for 3–16; non-smoking with a smoking area; children welcome; cards, transit IC, e-money and PayPay. Tabelog lists no service charge.
kyoto_mimasuya_okudohan.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Sanjo near City Hall, a machiya named for its kamado] A two-floor machiya near Kyoto City Hall serving obanzai with Fushimi sake: a nine-kind obanzai platter for ¥1,100, Saikyo-miso grilled fish, yuba-wrapped tsukune tempura, and ¥1,280 lunch sets with homemade ohagi. Courses from ¥2,980. A sister of The みます屋 on Pontocho. One solo diner at the counter felt in the way of the busy kitchen (September 2026). Closed Monday.

roles: Not named in a source; sister shop The みます屋 (Pontocho, 26004114)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm machiya restaurant on Sanjo near Kyoto City Hall, its name the Kyoto dialect for a kamado, with a counter facing an open kitchen, partitions upstairs, bright and attentive staff, and a crowd of both tourists and locals. Its name is shared with The みます屋 on Pontocho (26004114 in the crawl).
chef_bio.specialty: Nine-kind obanzai platter; Saikyo-miso grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: at the counter "it felt like I was eating in a corner of the busy kitchen, and I felt bad about placing my orders."
"The name 'Okudohan' refers to a 'kamado' in the Kyoto dialect." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: みます屋 おくどはん、居酒屋・創作料理・日本料理、中京区三条御幸町通上ル丸屋町318-3、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、火〜土 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日祝 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、月曜休み、50席 (1階20、2階30)、個室3〜16名、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、子供可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・PayPay可。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): 店名は京言葉のかまど、おばんざい9種盛り1,100円、本日の西京焼き880円、お造り、揚げ出し豆腐、おにぎり、つくねの湯葉巻き天ぷら、餅とモッツァレラと明太子の春巻、豚・牛・鶏の盛り合わせ、ランチの鯖味噌焼きとだし巻きの定食1,280円、西京焼きとデザートのセット、手作りのおはぎ、コース2,980円・3,980円、伏見の日本酒、地ビール、カウンターは忙しい厨房の隅のようで注文しづらかったという声、明るく丁寧なスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Obanzai platters to point at; counter or upstairs rooms.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_trattoria_m_mercure.gf_detail: Ask. Fresh pasta, lasagna, pizza and bread refills dominate; risotto is among the lunch mains; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_trattoria_m_mercure.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, smoked salmon, Tanba chicken, cheese and meat-sauce lasagna (2026 reviews).
kyoto_trattoria_m_mercure.hours_raw: Daily 6:30–10:00 (breakfast), 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed on irregular days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A 10% service charge since 1 April 2024 (Tabelog original 2024年4月1日以降サービス料10％頂戴いたします。). Half-price drinks at lunch during happy hour (May 2026). 80 seats: restaurant counter 8 and tables 24, bar counter 8 and tables 14; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards, transit IC and iD; no QR (Tabelog). 1F of the Mercure Kyoto Station hotel, in front of Nishi Honganji; 7–10 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_trattoria_m_mercure.notes: [Hotel Italian · by Nishi Honganji, Mercure 1F] The spacious, Japanese-accented trattoria and bar of the Mercure hotel near Kyoto Station: a good-value M Lunch of appetisers, soup and fresh pasta for ¥2,300, and by night Kyoto-tinged dishes such as a saikyo-miso Bismarck pizza or salmon with fresh yuba, with Kyoto gin. Calm even at lunch; service sometimes slow or new. Plus 10% service. Breakfast from 6:30.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Italian restaurant and bar of the Mercure Kyoto Station hotel, proposing a new "Kyoto Italian cuisine"; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a large, stylish room with a Japanese aesthetic and sofa seats on the hotel's first floor, opposite Nishi Honganji.
chef_bio.philosophy: A new "Kyoto Italian cuisine" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: M Lunch; Bismarck with saikyo miso.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest had to ask for the coffee long after dessert, and found the bill arriving before the drink was finished.
An August 2026 family with children found the staff friendly and enjoyed mixing Kyoto craft gin into cocktails after a hot day of sightseeing.
An October 2026 diner thought a new staff member mixed up the wine orders, and suggested reading from notes when unsure.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・バー・ピザ、下京区油小路町288 メルキュール京都ステーション、地下鉄・JR京都駅から徒歩7分、毎日 6:30〜10:00・11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00、ドリンクL.O.21:30)、不定休、予約可、2024年4月1日からサービス料10%、80席 (レストラン カウンター8・テーブル24、バー カウンター8・テーブル14)、禁煙、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、カード・交通系IC・iD 可、QR 不可、新しい「京都イタリアン」の提案。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): ホテルの1階、西本願寺の前、M ランチ2,300円 (前菜2種、本日のスープ、生パスタかリゾット)、ラザニアは追加料金、肉の追加、パンのおかわり、ランチのハッピーアワーでドリンク半額、生ハムとグラナ・パダーノ、西京味噌のビスマルク、スモークサーモンと生湯葉、Tanba の鶏とパンツァネッラ、ラザニア、マルゲリータ、チョコレートケーキ、京都のクラフトジン、コーヒーが遅れた・注文の取り違えとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel restaurant; 10% service; cards and IC.

kyoto_good_time_coffee_shimabara.gf_detail: Not GF: the food is toasted sandwiches and mochi toast on wheat bread (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_good_time_coffee_shimabara.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and juices suit, but both sandwiches use duck or sweet toppings with miso sauce, and no vegan information is given (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_good_time_coffee_shimabara.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–17:00; closed over the New Year holidays (Tabelog). No reservations; order and pay at the counter first, then sit (Tabelog; March and July 2026). Cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog; March 2026). 16 seats incl. a counter and a courtyard terrace; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; takeaway; coffee beans for sale (Tabelog; March 2026). A renovated old house down a side lane in a residential area near Shimabara; 2 min from the Shimabaraguchi bus stop, about 12 min walk from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_good_time_coffee_shimabara.notes: [Coffee · Shimabara back lane, renovated house] A quiet coffee stand tucked into a residential lane near Shimabara, with a courtyard terrace: order at the counter, choose your beans, then sit with a duck, Kujo negi and white-miso hot sandwich, or a white-peach mochi toast. No background music, coffee beans to take home. Self-service, so no table service. Open daily 9:00–17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café and sandwich shop near Shimabara with takeaway; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a slightly renovated old building in a hidden lane, beans to choose and buy, early opening, and many overseas visitors (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor waited here for the Setsubun event at nearby Renkyuji temple.
A March 2026 guest thought the place was takeaway only from outside — and, on asking, sat inside.
A July 2026 visitor wondered why so many inbound tourists find the lane, and noted there is no table service.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・サンドイッチ、下京区突抜2-357、JR梅小路京都西駅から徒歩12分、JR Tanbaguchi 駅から徒歩13分、市バス島原口から徒歩2分、毎日 9:00〜17:00、年末年始休み、予約不可、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可、16席、テラス、禁煙、子ども・ベビーカー可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 住宅街の路地、改装した古い建物、先にカウンターで注文と支払い、鴨ねぎのホットサンド990〜1,045円 (鴨むね、九条ねぎ、Tanba のしめじ、白味噌のソース)、白桃のもちトースト、豆を選べるドリップコーヒー (タンザニア、東ティモール、ブラジル660円)、カフェラテ、キャラメルラテ、りんごジュース605円、BGM なし、豆の販売、中庭、外国人客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter first; cards, IC and PayPay.

kyoto_spicy_masala_station.gf_detail: Not GF: a roux-style curry with breaded cutlet toppings (2026 reviews).
kyoto_spicy_masala_station.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable curry ¥950 is on the menu, but the base sauce's ingredients are not stated; the beef curry uses meat (October 2026).
kyoto_spicy_masala_station.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–21:00 (last order 20:30) (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Buy a ticket from the machine at the entrance; cutlets fried to order, served in about 5 minutes (2026 reviews). Cards and transit IC; no QR or PayPay; contactless cards not supported (Tabelog; October 2026). Counter seats only; non-smoking (Tabelog). On the 2F of JR Kyoto Station, next to the JR ticket office left of the Shinkansen central gate, with an entrance also from inside the ticket gates on the Nara Line side (Tabelog).
kyoto_spicy_masala_station.notes: [Curry · inside JR Kyoto Station, by the Shinkansen gate] A fast, cheap ticket-machine curry counter beside the Shinkansen central gate, reachable from both sides of the ticket barrier: freshly fried pork or chicken cutlets on a European-leaning curry, a cheese menchi katsu, a chunky vegetable curry, and a ¥150 cabbage side with refills. Ideal before a train; quick turnover even at noon. Daily 9:00–21:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a curry counter in the JR Kyoto Station building, next to the JR ticket office; registered as an official listing by the operator, with a page on the Kyoto Station Building website. Reviewers in 2026 describe frequent use by Shinkansen travellers changing trains.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a sixth visit eats here whenever there is time before the Shinkansen.
A September 2026 diner went back for the ¥150 cabbage four times.
An October 2026 business traveller admits coming not for the taste but out of habit, between Shinkansen and local train.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カレー・インドカレー、下京区東塩小路町657 JR京都駅 2F、新幹線中央口の左、JR きっぷうりばの隣、毎日 9:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、予約不可、カード・交通系IC 可、QR 不可、カウンター席のみ (奈良線側の改札内からも入れる)、禁煙。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): 入口の券売機、カツは揚げたて、約5分で出る、オリジナルのさらっとしたカレー、細かい肉の牛カレー、新幹線の食堂車を思わせる「プレミアム牛カレー」、チーズメンチカツカレー920円、厚切りロースカツカレー1,040円、チキンカツ、野菜カレー950円、キャベツ150円 (おかわり自由)、福神漬けとらっきょう、PayPay とタッチ決済は不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine; counter only; cards and IC, no QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_kumamoto_sogo_mao.gf_detail: Not GF: the signature is wheat-coated kara-age; lunch also has curry and pork kimchi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kumamoto_sogo_mao.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, pork curry and pork kimchi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kumamoto_sogo_mao.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Friday, Saturday and the day before a holiday 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sunday and holidays 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:30), with dinner to 23:00 on a Sunday before a holiday; closed on irregular days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised on holidays; one-hour limit at lunch (Tabelog; September 2026). Smartphone ordering, staff take orders if needed (October 2026). 80 seats, private rooms for 6–30+, banquets up to 60 seated (Tabelog). Cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). A high-ceilinged renovated machiya on Higashinotoin just north of Nishikikoji; 4 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_kumamoto_sogo_mao.notes: [Kara-age · Higashinotoin by Shijo Karasuma, all you can eat at lunch] A lofty renovated machiya near Nishiki Market whose lunch is famous for all-you-can-eat kara-age with free rice refills for about ¥1,300 — crisp, juicy and freshly fried, with ponzu, green-onion salt or shiba-zuke tartare to change it up — plus a daily special and a Kujo negi pork curry. Phone ordering; one-hour limit; book on holidays. Izakaya at night.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya, beer hall and canteen with private rooms for banquets; registered as an official listing by the operator. A sister concept, 隈本ハイカラ万遍飯店, appears in our crawls. Reviewers in 2026 describe a renovated Kyoto machiya with high ceilings like a lodge and a lunch crowd of office workers.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 regular has logged 23 visits, mostly for the kara-age lunch.
An October 2026 guest managed eleven pieces in three orders of five, four and two.
An October 2026 diner whose phone would not connect ordered from the staff, and chose the Kujo negi pork curry over the kara-age.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・ビアホール・食堂、中京区東洞院通り錦小路上る元竹田町644、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩4分、月〜木 11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、金・土・祝前日 11:00〜15:00・18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日・祝 11:00〜16:00 (L.O.15:30)、祝前の日曜は23時まで、不定休、定食は昼のみ、予約可、80席、個室、宴会 着席60名・立食100名、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): 天井の高い京町家、唐揚げ食べ放題1,200〜1,300円 (最初の個数を選ぶ、ご飯おかわり自由)、日替わり、日替わりと唐揚げのセット、味変 (ぽん酢、スイートチリ、ねぎ塩、七味マヨ、柴漬けタルタル50円)、粗挽き豚と九条ねぎのだしのポークカレー、豚キムチ、スマホで注文、昼は1時間制、休日は予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone ordering (staff can take orders); one-hour lunch limit; cards, IC and PayPay.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_cha_to_koji_tsukiakari.gf_detail: Ask. Koji- and miso-marinated grilled fish and chicken, sashimi with soy, curry; koji and miso can contain barley or wheat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cha_to_koji_tsukiakari.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but set meals centre on fish or chicken (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cha_to_koji_tsukiakari.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu 11:00–15:00; Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 17 seats with a counter; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Facing Nijo-dori just west of Higashidori-Nijo in Okazaki, near Heian Shrine; 2 min from the Higashiyama-Nijo bus stop, 10 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cha_to_koji_tsukiakari.notes: [Koji set meals · Okazaki near Heian Shrine] A café-like room on Nijo-dori serving gentle Japanese set meals: fish or chicken marinated in koji and grilled, with sashimi of the day, tofu and miso soup, about ¥1,800, plus hojicha sweets and koji natto to take home. Lunch daily but Wednesday; dinner Fri–Sun.

chef_bio.background: Opened 4 March 2020 (Tabelog). A December 2025 reviewer says the owner serves tea from the owner's home region ("Maruyoshi Omi tea").

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 return visitor came back for the hojicha and bought the koji natto to eat at home.
A September 2026 diner noted many regulars and a warm atmosphere from opening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 茶と糀つきあかり、日本料理、左京区正往寺町462-2 インペリアル岡崎 1F、東山駅から徒歩10分、市バス東山二条から徒歩2分、月火木 11:00〜15:00、金土日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜20:00、水曜休み、予約可、カード不可・電子マネー・QR 可、17席、禁煙、子供可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2020年3月4日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 糀に漬けた魚や鶏の焼き物御膳 (鯖1,800円、ぶり、鰆、はまち)、魚と鶏のハーフ +400円、刺身3種、豆腐、海鮮丼、まぐろの中落ち丼、糀納豆の「海山丼」、カレー、冬は糀甘酒と味噌のにしんと粕汁、ほうじ茶のデザート、店主の故郷のお茶、自家製しそジュース350円、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Daily fish listed on a blackboard.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through September 2026.
