kyoto_kissa_kishin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breakfasts centre on koji bread, Danish and French toast (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_kishin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omelettes, French toast, chirimen-sansho and dairy soups (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_kishin.hours_raw: Mon and Thu–Sun 7:30–13:30 (last order 13:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). No bookings; full from opening on some mornings (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). Cards (AMEX), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 18 seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). In a renovated house with big windows onto greenery, in front of Toyokuni Shrine near the old Great Buddha Hall site; 10 min from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_kishin.notes: [Breakfast café · by Toyokuni Shrine] The Western-breakfast sister of Gion's 朝食 喜心: a bright room with greenery outside, serving fluffy omelettes, seasonal soups and koji bread from 7:30 — about ¥2,400–2,800 with a drink extra. Fills fast with travellers; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 September 2022 (Tabelog). Per the official site: the Kishin project runs 朝食 喜心 breakfasts in Kyoto (Gion) and Kamakura; the name comes from a Zen teaching that cooking and eating are training and a joyful act. Reviewers call this the Western-style sister of the Gion breakfast (December 2024, June 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: A hearty breakfast with Japanese spirit, inspired by home cooking (official site).

anecdotes.text: At 9:00 on a May 2026 weekday the room was full, and every other guest was a foreign visitor.
A June 2026 diner found one server struggling with orders, but loved the mibuna quiche.
An August 2025 visitor looked out on the site of Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Great Buddha Hall while eating the Kishin omelette.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 朝食 喜心、喜心とは「人を良くする」と書く食、禅の教え、京都 (祇園) と鎌倉の朝食、喫茶。食べログ (店舗会員): 喫茶 喜心 kyoto、喫茶店、東山区妙法院前側町427-18 Maana Kiyomizu、七条駅から564m、月木金土日 7:30〜13:30 (L.O. 13:00)、火水休み、予約不可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、18席、禁煙、子供可、2022年9月2日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年7月、英語): Toyokuni Shrine の前、祇園の朝食喜心の姉妹店、喜心の洋朝食2,800円 (かぼちゃやえんどう豆のスープ、糀パン、オムレツ、焼き野菜、ちりめん山椒、漬物)、喜心オムレツ2,400円、トマトときのこのオムレツ、フレンチトースト、壬生菜のキッシュ、チョコレートガトー、コーヒーの氷のアイスコーヒー、外国人客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Official site in English; many international guests (2024–26 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop and the official site; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_kissa_kishin.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26038151/ (34.991587, 135.773382); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区妙法院前側町427番地 (lot) 122m; 2026-11-06

kyoto_ryotei_yachiyo_nanzenji.gf_detail: Ask. Yudofu and yuba with soy-based dipping sauce, shojin tempura and sesame tofu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryotei_yachiyo_nanzenji.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options, and yudofu sets include shojin tempura, but broths may use dashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryotei_yachiyo_nanzenji.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last orders food 14:00, drinks 14:45) and 17:00–21:00 (last orders food 19:30, drinks 20:45), daily; Tabelog also notes lunch to 16:00 (last order 15:00) (Tabelog). Bookings taken; kaiseki from ¥6,000 must be booked ahead; seat-only bookings may limit the menu (Tabelog). Private garden rooms (8) add 10% service up to ¥5,500 per person and 15% on kaiseki above (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 80 seats: tatami, sunken seats and tables facing the garden, two terrace seats; children welcome with a kids' menu; non-smoking; parking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the Nanzenji approach by the Incline; 5 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryotei_yachiyo_nanzenji.notes: [Yudofu & kaiseki · Nanzenji approach] A long-established garden restaurant on the way to Nanzenji, with tatami and table rooms looking onto a koi pond: Nanzenji yudofu sets with yuba, sesame tofu and shojin tempura (about ¥3,500–4,000), summer chilled tofu, or kaiseki by reservation. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 24 December 1950 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Kyoto cuisine and Nanzenji yudofu in a calm Japanese setting (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: Watching the koi in August 2026, a child was invited by staff to feed them.
An October 2026 guide bringing honeymooners from New York found the couple satisfied, but felt an air of superiority bordering on over-politeness in the service.
A September 2026 diner enjoyed the ¥3,500 course but felt that much tofu was a one-time experience.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 料庭 八千代、日本料理・豆腐料理・すき焼き、左京区南禅寺福地町34、蹴上駅1番出口から徒歩5分、11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:00 (ランチは16:00まで L.O. 15:00 とも)、無休、予約可 (6,000円以上の会席は要予約)、庭園個室8室はサービス料10% (5,500円まで) または15% (5,500円超の会席)、80席 (座敷、掘りごたつ、庭に面したテーブル)、子供可・キッズメニュー、禁煙、駐車場、カード・PayPay 可、1950年12月24日オープン、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアンメニューあり、インクラインと南禅寺参道に面する。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 南禅寺名物湯豆腐、竹 (生湯葉付き) 4,000円、3,500円のコース、湯葉しゃぶ御膳、冷やしおぼろ豆腐、ごま豆腐、精進揚げ、八寸、鯉の池の庭、テラス席、サービスが慇懃すぎるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set menus; garden rooms by reservation.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the restaurant; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_ryotei_yachiyo_nanzenji.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26001833/ (35.011076, 135.789207); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市左京区南禅寺福地町34番地 (lot) 36m; 2026-11-06

kyoto_nishiki_hirano.gf_detail: Ask. Dashimaki, grilled fish and obanzai beside tempura, udon and soba; soy-based dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nishiki_hirano.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashimaki with dashi, fish, beef (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nishiki_hirano.hours_raw: Breakfast 8:30–10:30 (last order 10:15) and lunch 11:00–16:30 (last food order 16:00), daily except New Year and occasional closures; Tabelog also gives eat-in 10:00–19:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 50 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; take-out of dashimaki and obanzai (Tabelog). Inside Nishiki Market; 6 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_nishiki_hirano.notes: [Dashimaki breakfast · Nishiki Market] The dining room of a century-old Nishiki obanzai shop: from 8:30, trays of freshly rolled dashimaki with thick smoked salmon or mackerel, obanzai and a dashi chazuke finish, about ¥2,000–2,750; tempura and soba sets at lunch. Busy with visitors; book ahead.

roles: Company representative 岡 篤 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an obanzai specialist in Nishiki Market, "raised by customers particular about flavour", hand-grilling dashimaki daily and selling wholesale; a July 2026 reviewer calls it over 100 years old.
chef_bio.philosophy: The unchanging taste of Kyoto, handmade daily (official site).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 breakfast guest found the ¥1,800 dashimaki gozen unavailable and settled for smoked mackerel; plenty of foreigners were eating too.
An October 2026 diner found the dashimaki thinner than in photos and too wet with dashi, though the salmon was generous.
A September 2026 solo diner expected something more traditional and found it geared to international visitors, many buying dashimaki to eat in.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 錦 平野、京都・錦市場のお惣菜専門店、変わらぬ京都の味を毎日手作り、出汁を大切に一本一本手焼きのだし巻き、業務用商品、レストラン、中京区錦堺町東入、代表 岡 篤。食べログ (店舗会員): 錦 平野、日本料理・揚げ物、中京区錦小路通堺町東入ル中魚屋町489-1、烏丸駅から徒歩6分、朝 8:30〜10:30 (L.O. 10:15)、昼 11:00〜16:30 (L.O. 16:00)、イートイン 10:00〜19:00 とも、年末年始ほか不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、50席、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 百年以上の老舗、焼きたてだし巻きとりんごで燻した銀鮭の御膳2,750円、鯖の燻製の朝食1,980円、おばんざい、ご飯のおかわり、出汁茶漬け、和牛とだし巻きの御膳2,300円、天ぷらとざるそば、天ぷらうどん、山椒の稲荷寿司、外国人客が多い、だし巻きが薄いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set menus with photos; busy with international visitors.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop and the official site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_nishiki_hirano.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26007725/ (35.004960, 135.763488); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区中魚屋町489番地 (lot) 18m; 16.9 m from kyoto_fuka_nishiki; 2026-11-06

kyoto_conto_oike.gf_detail: Ask. The waffles are homemade and gluten-free (August 2026) and the cone is made to an original rice-flour recipe (September 2026), but the bomboloni are fried dough and one ice cream has baked rice granola; no information on shared equipment.
kyoto_conto_oike.vegan_detail: Some: the ice cream is vegan — caramel, kinako, hojicha and brown sugar, yuzu soy milk, carrot cake and other seasonal flavours (July–September 2026 reviews). Ask about the bomboloni.
kyoto_conto_oike.hours_raw: 7:30–19:00 daily, sometimes to 21:00 (Tabelog). Bomboloni from 10:30 (August 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (JCB), Suica-type e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」; Tabelog’s English wrongly says one may be added). Tiny: standing room for 2–3 and a bench outside shared with the queue (Tabelog; June 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Oike west of Koromonotana; 225 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 10 April 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_conto_oike.notes: [Ice cream and doughnuts · Karasuma Oike, a tiny vegan scoop shop] A stand-up shop on Oike run by two women, scooping vegan ice cream in flavours like salted-koji caramel coffee, kinako with cacao nibs and grapefruit with cucumber (from ¥650), in a rice-flour cone or with gluten-free waffles, plus bomboloni fried to order from 10:30. Open from 7:30; eat on the bench outside.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a doughnut shop opened 10 April 2025. Reviews describe vegan ice cream, Tunisian bomboloni, homemade gluten-free waffles and rice-flour cones.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor said one would never guess the kinako ice cream was vegan, and paired it with the gluten-free waffle.
A July 2026 visitor called the carrot-cake ice cream genius-level, in a three-scoop cup for ¥1,100.
A September 2026 visitor saw couples and overseas visitors arriving in search of vegan options.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ドーナツ、中京区御池通衣棚西入西横町174-1 1F、烏丸御池駅から225m、7:30〜19:00 (21:00まで延長あり)、予約不可、カード (JCB)・交通系電子マネー・PayPay 可、チャージなし、立ち席2〜3名と外のベンチ、禁煙、2025年4月10日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年9月、英語): ヴィーガンのアイス (塩麹キャラメルコーヒー、完熟梅、きな粉とカカオニブ、ほうじ茶と黒糖、塩麹バニラと焼き米グラノーラ、キャロットケーキ、グレープフルーツと胡瓜、柚子豆乳、かぼちゃ)、シングル大650円、3種1,100円、ボンボローニ (10時半から、ミニ330円)、自家製のグルテンフリーのワッフル、米粉のコーン、女性二人で営む。

cultural_comfort.note: Point and order at the counter; many overseas visitors come for the vegan ice cream (September 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_conto_oike.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26042890/ (35.011059, 135.757191); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区西横町174番地 (lot) 13m; 2026-11-06

kyoto_hitohi_higashiyama.gf_detail: Ask. Wood-fired plates with homemade bread and focaccia, pasta at lunch (2025–26 reviews); the shop asks for allergies to be told in advance (Tabelog).
kyoto_hitohi_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal vegetables, hummus and soups, but breakfast is bacon, eggs and cheese and mains include fish and pork (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hitohi_higashiyama.hours_raw: Wed–Sat and holidays 11:30–18:00 (last order 17:00); Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30); closed Monday and Tuesday; dinner in two sittings at 18:00 and 19:30 (Tabelog). Breakfast is also served (November 2025, April 2026) — check times when booking. Reservations recommended for breakfast and lunch, same-day seating possible; tables may be shared; more than 30 minutes late without word counts as a cancellation (Tabelog). One drink per person (October 2025, April 2026). Service charge 10% at dinner only (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「ディナーのみサービス料10％」). Cards (incl. UnionPay) and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). In a residential street, 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Opened 26 March 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hitohi_higashiyama.notes: [Wood-fired dining · Higashiyama, a Meiji machiya from breakfast to dinner] A restaurant in a 120-year-old townhouse a short walk from the Okazaki museums, cooking everything over a wood fire: a ¥2,800 breakfast of homemade bacon, eggs and focaccia, choose-your-own lunch courses, and an eight-course dinner. Lovely room and staff; some found lunch pricey for what it was, with one drink each required. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (shop text): an all-day restaurant in a 120-year-old machiya, with oven-baked breakfast plates, seasonal Kyoto à la carte cooked over an open fire at lunch, and an eight-course omakase at dinner; opened 26 March 2025. Tabelog links it to Com-ion, a building that describes itself as a place for people to eat, shop, rest and gather (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: The seasons of Kyoto cooked over an open fire (Tabelog, shop text).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 breakfast guest found the bacon crisp and light thanks to the wood fire, though the pumpkin soup arrived cool, and noticed the staff sweating in short sleeves by the fire.
An April 2026 diner in the food trade found the one-drink rule, a hummus served without bread, and fish from ¥3,900 explained in a single line too many issues.
A June 2026 group came on from the Kyocera Museum and shared dishes under the original Meiji-era beams.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: レストラン、東山区堀池町382-1、東山駅から徒歩約5分、水〜土・祝11:30〜18:00 (L.O. 17:00)、日11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)、月火休み、夜は18:00と19:30の2部制、朝と昼は予約優先、相席の場合あり、ディナーのみサービス料10%、カード・QR 可、30席、禁煙、2025年3月26日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 築120年の町家、朝は窯焼きのプレート、昼は直火の京都の旬のアラカルト、夜は8品のおまかせ。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年6月、英語): 朝食2,800円 (自家製ベーコン、卵、ソーセージ、季節の野菜、チーズ、かぼちゃのスープ、自家製フォカッチャ)、選べる昼のコース (最大約8,900円)、鱸のタルタル、フムス、焼き魚3,900円から、1ドリンク制、昼は高めとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book for breakfast or lunch; tables may be shared; one drink each. Staff explain the drinks (October 2025). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_jijibaba_mokubatei.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: Napolitan spaghetti, dry curry and other noodle and rice sets at lunch (2026 reviews).
kyoto_jijibaba_mokubatei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: venison and other game, bacon-topped Napolitan with cream and cheese, mapo tofu (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_jijibaba_mokubatei.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and days before and after holidays: lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Lunch serves only noodle and rice sets (July 2026). Reservations accepted; please order drinks too; 2-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). Charge ¥440 per person with a snack since 1 December 2024 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「令和6年12月1日よりチャージ料440円（おつまみ付）あり」). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay (Tabelog). 42 seats: 12 at the counter, tables for up to 30; private hire possible (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On a corner 1 min north of Karasuma Oike Stn exit 1 (Tabelog). Opened 10 October 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_jijibaba_mokubatei.notes: [Western-style izakaya · Karasuma Oike, venison and a 600 g Napolitan] The fourth shop of Kyoto’s Jijibaba counter bars: a bistro-izakaya by Karasuma Oike Stn with a wooden horse in the middle, serving Tanba-Sasayama venison, mapo tofu and carpaccio at night, and a famous bacon-and-cheese Napolitan at lunch (¥1,250 for 600 g with salad). Half portions for solo diners; ¥440 charge. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who sources vegetables from home (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: じじばば 木馬亭 is the fourth shop of a counter-bar group long loved in Kyoto, a bar-like Western izakaya near Karasuma Oike Stn using venison sent direct from Tanba-Sasayama and seasonal vegetables from the owner’s home area. Data has the group’s 酒肴屋 じじばば in the Rido alley (kyoto_sakenoateya_jijibaba). Opened 10 October 2017 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Good food regardless of genre, to go with sake, wine and beer (official site).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 group noticed the wooden horse at the centre of the tables and winning betting tickets on display, and guessed the owner is a racing fan.
A June 2026 group of five was offered 30 more minutes of all-you-can-drink for ¥500.
A July 2026 lunch visitor came for the venison but found only noodle and rice sets at lunchtime.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: じじばば 木馬亭 (じじばば もくばてい)、京都で名店として長年愛されるカウンター酒場の4店舗目、烏丸御池のおしゃれな洋風居酒屋、丹波篠山直送の鹿肉、店主の地元の旬の野菜、ジビエ、麻婆豆腐、ナポリタン、カルパッチョ、一人には料理をハーフサイズで、飲み放題付きコース、貸切可。食べログ: ダイニングバー・ビストロ・ワインバー、中京区西押小路町106 1F、烏丸御池駅1番出口から徒歩1分、月〜土 昼11:30〜14:00・夜17:00〜22:00、日祝休み、チャージ440円 (おつまみ付き、2024年12月から)、42席、禁煙、2017年10月10日オープン。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): ナポリタン大盛600gとサラダ1,250円、チーズ追加80円、ドライカレー、昼は麺とご飯のセットのみ、飲み放題90分 (30分延長500円)、木馬と馬券、クラフトビール。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter for solo diners with half portions, tables for groups; order a drink too; ¥440 charge. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_futagoya_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, temari sushi and fried dishes such as chicken nanban (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_futagoya_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetable-led, but obanzai sets come with bonito rice and miso soup, and temari sushi and chicken nanban are fish and meat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_futagoya_pontocho.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seat requests cannot be guaranteed; time limits 1.5 h at lunch and 2 h at dinner (Tabelog). Appetizer ¥400 (¥550 on 1–4 January, plus a 10% New Year service charge) (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「お通し代 400円※1月1日〜4日 550円（税込）※1月1日から4日（正月期間）別途、お正月サービス料としてお会計より＋10%頂戴致します」). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). 62 seats: 10 at the counter, a table for 4, a 30-seat tatami room and a 30-seat semi-private sunken-kotatsu room; window seats over the Kamo River (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). 2nd floor of エメラルド会館 on Pontocho south of Sanjo; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_futagoya_pontocho.notes: [Vegetable obanzai · Pontocho, river views from the second floor] A vegetable-focused izakaya above Pontocho with windows on the Kamo River: obanzai and temari sushi sets at lunch with refillable salad, braised beef tendon and courses (from ¥7,000) at night. Popular and busy; one October 2026 diner waited 30 minutes for lukewarm food. Ask for a window seat. ¥400 appetizer charge.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a vegetable-focused izakaya on the 2nd floor of エメラルド会館 in Pontocho; Tabelog also lists a sister shop, 炭火酒場 ふたご家 京都西院.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner booked a semi-private room, asked to move to a table with a view, and was kindly given one.
An October 2026 diner waited over 30 minutes for a pre-ordered lunch and found the miso soup lukewarm and the temari sushi thin on fish.
An October 2026 visitor with a baby appreciated the tatami seating.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、中京区先斗町通三条下ル橋下町133-1 エメラルド会館 2F、三条駅から徒歩3分、昼11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、夜17:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可、席の指定不可、昼1.5時間・夜2時間制、お通し400円 (1月1日〜4日は550円、別途正月のサービス料10%)、カード・PayPay 可、62席 (カウンター10、テーブル4、座敷30、半個室の掘りごたつ30)、禁煙。口コミ (2026年10月〜11月、英語): 野菜中心の料理、手まり寿司御膳、おばんざい5種の御膳 (かつおご飯)、おかわり自由のサラダ、桜鶏の南蛮と梅のタルタル、湯葉丼、牛すじ煮込み、7,000円のコース、昼の120分飲み放題4,200円、鴨川を望む窓、料理が遅くぬるかったとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; set meals at lunch; ask for a river-view seat. Many overseas guests (October 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_cafe_kanade_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch sets of hamburg steak, beef stew (bread or rice), green curry, marinated mackerel, pork miso soup with side dishes; cakes; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kanade_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Lunch plates come with plenty of fried and grilled vegetables, but mains are meat or fish and dashi is not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kanade_marutamachi.hours_raw: 11:00–20:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog; hours may change). Lunch menu until 15:00 (February 2025). Reservations accepted; weekend tables fill with bookings (Tabelog; May 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats including counter; window seats onto a small garden with goldfish (Tabelog; September 2025). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya at the corner of Sakaimachi and Marutamachi, about 350 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2025). Opened 7 October 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_kanade_marutamachi.notes: [Café · Sakaimachi-Marutamachi, a machiya with goldfish] A bright, calm café in a renovated townhouse by the Imperial Palace, with a little garden of goldfish: good-value lunch sets (beef stew ¥1,350, pork miso soup ¥950, marinated mackerel) heaped with vegetables, then Unir coffee, cakes and zenzai in the afternoon. Popular with locals and nearby workers. Cash only; closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. Reviewers describe a homey café used by people working nearby, with solo diners at lunch (2026).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor had lunch here before the gallery across the street and was surprised to find a Kyoto lunch under ¥1,000 by the Imperial Palace.
An October 2026 visitor, tense after a dentist’s appointment, was comforted by the homey room over a royal milk tea.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ 奏、カフェ、中京区橘町88、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩2分 (347m)、11:00〜20:00、木曜定休、予約可、現金のみ、20席、禁煙、子ども可、2016年10月7日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 町家のカフェ、坪庭と金魚、昼は15時まで、ビーフシチュー定食1,350円、ハンバーグ、満足セット、グリーンカレー、豚汁定食950円、鯖の南蛮漬け、コーヒーセット300円、長岡京の Unir の豆のフレンチプレスのブレンド600円、本日のケーキ550円、ぜんざい、抹茶ラテ、ほうじ茶ラテ。

cultural_comfort.note: Homey local café; lunch sets; cash only.

kyoto_kyou_yuuke_yokikana.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto kappo courses — sashimi, clear soups, grilled sweetfish, clam rice — with soy and dashi; the shop asks guests to declare allergies when booking (Tabelog; 2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyou_yuuke_yokikana.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based Kyoto cooking with fish and shellfish (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyou_yuuke_yokikana.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 13:00), dinner 17:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the shop asks callers to phone before 17:00 or after 22:00, as evenings are busy, and to mention any food allergies (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, original サービス料10%). Cards (Tabelog). 14 seats, up to 20: 6 at the counter and three private rooms for 2–16, including a sunken-kotatsu room at the back (Tabelog; July 2025). On Muromachi north of Ebisugawa, down a quiet alley, 5 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 6 (Tabelog; 2024–2025).
kyoto_kyou_yuuke_yokikana.notes: [Kyoto kappo · Muromachi near Marutamachi, a chef from Toriimoto] A quiet townhouse down an alley off Muromachi where owner-chef Yoshitaka Sasai, long trained at Gion’s Toriimoto, cooks seasonal Kyoto courses served in private rooms or at a six-seat counter: thick sashimi, grilled ayu, clam rice and delicate dashi. A Michelin-starred address, per a 2024 reviewer. 10% service charge; closed Wednesdays.

roles: Owner-chef; also the invoice holder (NTA register)
chef_bio.background: An April 2012 review: “The owner, Yoshitaka Sasai, trained for a long time at the renowned restaurant ‘Toriimoto’ in Gion”, then worked at well-known places in Nagaokakyo and central Kyoto before opening in a townhouse. The Tabelog invoice number T6810343961900 is registered to 笹井 喜晃 (NTA register). Reviewers praise the owner’s hospitality (2023–2024); a 2023 diner found the part-time staff’s service only average; a November 2024 reviewer mentions a Michelin star.

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 diner was served the leftover clam rice as onigiri, and a miso-cured egg yolk in a hōzuki husk said to be modelled on a dish from the manga “Oishinbo”.
A July 2025 guest was welcomed with “Okoshiyasu” and led down the alley to a sunken-kotatsu room at the back.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京夕け 善哉、日本料理、中京区室町通夷川上ル鏡屋町44-3、丸太町駅6番出口から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (料理L.O.13:00)、夜17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.20:00)、水曜定休、予約可 (夕方は電話に出にくいので17時前か22時以降に)、アレルギーは必ず伝えること、サービス料10%、カード可、14席 (最大20、カウンター6、個室3つで2〜16名)、適格請求書 T6810343961900 (笹井 喜晃)。口コミ (2012〜2026年、英語): 店主 Yoshitaka Sasai は祇園の Toriimoto で長く修業し、長岡京や街中の名店を経て町家で独立、厚切りの刺身と肝、鮎の焼き物、ほおずきの卵黄の味噌漬け、蛤ご飯とおにぎり、日本酒5〜6種、ミシュランの星との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone bookings before 17:00 or after 22:00; private rooms; 10% service charge.

kyoto_7_taps_tavern_station.gf_detail: Ask. About 90 Italian dishes with Kyoto ingredients — pasta, pizza, pintxos, grills, desserts; no gluten information (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_7_taps_tavern_station.vegan_detail: Ask. A large menu with salads and vegetables, but no vegan dishes are named; most plates use meat, fish or cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_7_taps_tavern_station.hours_raw: 11:00–24:00 daily (grand-menu food L.O. 22:00, bar food L.O. 23:00); special New Year hours; on the second Tuesday of each month the kitchen closes 15:00–17:00 (café and bar only) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online too; 2-hour limit when busy; bookings held 15 minutes (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 104 seats including sofas; views of Kyoto Tower from some tables (Tabelog; October 2026). Kyoto Station Building East Zone 1F, below the Kyoto Theater and opposite The Thousand Kyoto hotel, 1 min from the Central Exit (Tabelog). Opened 24 January 2025 (2026 review).
kyoto_7_taps_tavern_station.notes: [Italian and craft beer · Kyoto Station Central Exit, open 11:00–24:00] A big, stylish all-day restaurant under the Kyoto Theater, a minute from the station gates: Kyoto-ingredient Italian (heshiko-and-Kujo-onion pasta, Nanatani duck, matcha Basque cheesecake), four house craft beers brewed in Fukuchiyama, and plenty of wine. Lunch course ¥2,640; useful before a train. Service from student staff draws some complaints.

roles: Three chefs (unnamed); operated by イコン株式会社
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text credits three chefs. Invoice T7130001026710 is registered to イコン株式会社 of Shimogyo-ku, Kyoto (NTA register). An October 2026 diner found the food just okay; another noted student staff setting down dishes without explanation (October 2026), while a birthday group was given a surprise plate (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto ingredients in Italian cooking (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 group of four booked a birthday plate that was not on the listing, and the staff added it anyway; the group stayed three hours on the sofas.
An October 2026 diner booked online and got a table with a view of Kyoto Tower.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Pub & Grill 7 TAPS TAVERN 京都駅、イタリアン・バル・ビアホール、下京区東塩小路町901 京都駅ビル東ゾーン1F、Kyoto Theater の下、The Thousand Kyoto の向かい、中央口から徒歩1分、11:00〜24:00 (グランドメニューL.O.22:00、バーフードL.O.23:00)、毎月第2火曜15〜17時は厨房メンテナンス、予約可 (混雑時2時間制、15分遅れで取消)、カード・電子マネー可、104席、店の紹介: 3人のシェフの京食材のイタリアン約90品 330円から (亀岡の Nanatani 鴨、Kyoto Mochi 豚、抹茶のバスクチーズケーキ)、オリジナル4種を含む生ビール7種、ワイン60種以上、季節のカクテル、飲み放題コース5,000円から。適格請求書 T7130001026710 (イコン株式会社)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 福知山で造るクラフトビール、パイント1,650円、ランチコース2,640円、熟成へしこと九条ねぎのアーリオオーリオ、2025年1月24日開店、学生スタッフの接客に不満の声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Large station restaurant; online booking; 2-hour limit when busy.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with an October 2026 notice; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_yugen_tea_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese tea with wagashi — seasonal yokan, ohagi, fried sesame dumplings, yubeshi, kakigori with red-bean soup; ingredients are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yugen_tea_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tea is plant-based and a shojin sesame dumpling comes with oat-milk gelato (December 2025), but the other sweets are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yugen_tea_marutamachi.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); closed Thursday and irregular days — see Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised; booked about two weeks ahead in September 2026 (Tabelog; September 2026). Seasonal wagashi sell out by mid-afternoon (June and December 2025). Cards, IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 11 counter seats, high chairs — children welcome but warned of the chair height (Tabelog; December 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Gallery and shop on the 2nd and 3rd floors, shoes changed to enter (December 2025). 1 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yugen_tea_marutamachi.notes: [Japanese tea · by Marutamachi Stn, a tea counter with a gallery] An elegant 11-seat counter where tea is brewed in front of you over several infusions and matcha is whisked in a bowl you choose, paired with seasonal wagashi (about ¥1,600–2,100). Pottery gallery and shop upstairs. Book ahead; seasonal sweets sell out. Featured on NHK’s “Bi no Tsubo”; English explanations given.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. Reviewers note English explanations for overseas guests (December 2025), about half of the guests from abroad (September 2026), and a feature on NHK’s “Bi no Tsubo” (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Japanese tea in several infusions; matcha; seasonal wagashi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor was surprised that the first infusion tasted almost like dashi and each later one differed.
A September 2025 visitor came for the pottery and stayed for matcha and a walnut wagashi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: YUGEN、カフェ、中京区亀屋町146、丸太町駅から徒歩1分、11:00〜18:00 (L.O.17:30)、木曜と不定休 (インスタグラムで案内)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、11席、子ども可だが椅子が高い、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 日本茶と和菓子、煎茶、ほうじ茶 (3種の淹れ方)、紅茶、抹茶、選べる抹茶碗、3煎まで、水無月とお茶2,000円、季節の羊羹と抹茶1,600円、精進の胡麻団子とオーツミルクのジェラート2,100円、いちじくのおはぎ、かき氷、2・3階はギャラリーと販売、NHK の Bi no Tsubo で紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain in English (December 2025); counter only with high chairs; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_ogawa_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Japanese courses with soy-seasoned dishes, sushi and donabe rice with condiments; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_ogawa_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led Japanese courses with dashi (official site; reviews).
kyoto_ogawa_karasuma.hours_raw: Lunch Monday–Saturday from 12:00 (all start at 12:00, closing 14:00); dinner Monday–Saturday, arrival 18:00–19:00, closing 21:30; closed Sunday (official site). No service charge (official menu; Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「無し」 — the English page wrongly says 10%). Lunch is cash only; dinner takes cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, Discover) (official site). Cancellation or changes on the day or the day before are charged 100% (official site). Smart casual, no perfume; children from junior-high age, eating the adult menu; BYO by arrangement (official site). 11 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking (official site; Tabelog). About 10 min from Karasuma-Oike or Karasuma Stn (official site). Opened 2010; at the present Karasuma address since 2024 at the latest (official site; September 2024 review).
kyoto_ogawa_karasuma.notes: [Kaiseki · west of Karasuma-Oike, a Sasaki-trained chef's counter] An eleven-seat counter where chef 小川洋輔 (Ogawa), trained at Kyoto Kitcho and Gion Sasaki, cooks seasonal Kyoto cuisine with farm-direct vegetables and market fish, ending with rice from the donabe and plenty to go with it. Lunch courses from ¥5,500 (cash only) are the gentle way in; dinner is ¥28,000. Michelin one star per the restaurant. Junior-high age and up. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born in 1976 in Chiba Prefecture; trained from 1996 at 京都吉兆 and from 2002 at 祇園さゝ木 (listed as Michelin three stars); opened おが和 in 2010 (listed as Michelin one star). Tabelog’s official introduction names the owner as Ogawa, combining traditional technique with new ideas; reviewers note a move to the present Karasuma address by September 2024. Tabelog gives the surname in English as Ogawa.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: on choosing to cook, the chef’s father said "study Japanese cuisine", words the chef is still grateful for; "SHARE FROM KYOTO" — cherishing the bounty of Kyoto and Japan for the next generation.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal course ending in donabe rice.

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 diner loved the corn soup’s texture and the melon-soda dessert, and found the chef’s smile charming.
A November 2025 lunch guest found the donabe rice with its many accompaniments the real highlight.
A May 2024 first-timer found the food delicious but the kitchen uncommunicative.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-ogawa.com): おが和、京都烏丸の日本料理店、シェフ 小川洋輔、1976年 千葉県出身、1996年 京都吉兆、2002年 祇園さゝ木 (ミシュラン三つ星)、2010年 おが和 OPEN (ミシュラン一つ星)、父の「日本料理を学びなさい」という言葉、SHARE FROM KYOTO。昼のコース5,500円・12,100円 (税込、カード不可、サービス料なし)、夜のコース28,000円、佃煮3種のお土産5,000円 (税別、要予約)。中京区姉西洞院町515、地下鉄烏丸御池・阪急烏丸から徒歩10分、昼 月〜土12:00〜14:00、夜 月〜土18:00〜21:30 (入店18:00〜19:00)、日曜定休、カウンター11席、当日・前日のキャンセルは100%、スマートカジュアルで香水は控えて、中学生以上、持ち込み相談可、全面禁煙。食べログ: 日本料理、サービス料無し、11席、貸切可、公式紹介: 京都と全国の食材、農家直送の野菜、市場の魚、土鍋ご飯、関西の日本酒、店主 Ogawa。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 烏丸への移転、八寸、とうもろこしのスープ、握り、土鍋ご飯、メロンソーダのデザート。

cultural_comfort.note: English website; lunch is cash only.

existence.note: Official site with current menu and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_shokudo_endo.gf_detail: Ask. Tuna bowls dressed with a gochujang-based marinade, miso soup and sides; no gluten information is published (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_endo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 daily; closed irregularly; hours may change (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 seats — a few at the counter and two tables for four, on uneven floors with steps; cards accepted (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews). Busy with tourists and school trips in season (September 2025). A red-fronted house in a residential lane off Sannenzaka, about 5 min from Kiyomizu-dera; take the left path at the steps from Ninenzaka to Sannenzaka (2025 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_endo.notes: [Seafood bowls · Sannenzaka, a quiet tuna-bowl lunch near Kiyomizu] A small red-fronted canteen tucked off the crowds of Sannenzaka, with a homely, slightly Ghibli-like interior. The draw is a generous bowl of lean tuna marinated Korean-style with gochujang — about ¥1,200, with miso soup and a pot of tea — and a few other donburi. A welcome escape from the Kiyomizu crowds. Lunch only; closed irregularly.

chef_bio.background: Per 2023–2026 reviews: a small lunch canteen off Sannenzaka that, despite its name, focuses on tuna, especially a gochujang-dressed tuna bowl; it attracts locals, overseas visitors and school groups.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 parent and child escaping the crowds had the Oome and Nishiki bowls, each with miso soup and tea in a little pot.
A May 2024 visitor hesitated at the residential setting but found a quirky, Ghibli-like interior inside.
A September 2025 diner found it lively with overseas visitors and school-trip students.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂エンドウ、海鮮丼・豆腐料理・食堂、東山区清水2-241-4、11:30〜15:00、不定休、10席、カード可。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 三年坂から少し入った住宅街、赤い外観、清水寺から徒歩5分、店内はジブリのような雰囲気で段差あり、コチュジャンで和えた鮪の丼1,200円 (2024年9月)、オオメ丼と錦丼に味噌汁と小鉢と急須のお茶 (2026年5月)、観光客や修学旅行生でにぎわう。

cultural_comfort.note: Small and busy in season; steps inside.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_shokudo_endo.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26019711/ (34.996426, 135.781676); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区清水二丁目241番地 (lot) 25m; 2026-11-06

kyoto_maison_tanuki.gf_detail: Ask. Afternoon tea, plated desserts, parfaits and baked goods; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_maison_tanuki.vegan_detail: Ask. Cream- and dairy-rich desserts; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
kyoto_maison_tanuki.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00 daily (last order 17:30) (Tabelog). Bookings recommended, especially for afternoon tea; walk-ins join a smartphone waiting list (July 2026). No cover charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「チャージ料なし」). 60 seats over two floors, including sofas; groups up to 8; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards, transit IC and other e-money, and QR (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya more than 100 years old, about 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (256 m) (Tabelog; press reports). Opened May 2023 by モンテステリース有限会社 (press release; invoice).
kyoto_maison_tanuki.notes: [Café · Karasuma-Oike, afternoon tea in a century-old machiya] A salon-style café spread over two floors of a renovated hundred-year-old townhouse west of Karasuma-Oike. The draw is a seasonal afternoon tea with free-flow drinks — peach in summer, Shine Muscat in autumn — and plated dessert courses built on contrasts of texture and temperature; parfaits and kakigori too. Book for afternoon tea. Open daily.

roles: Pâtissier not named; operator モンテステリース有限会社
chef_bio.background: Per press releases: a salon-style café opened in May 2023 by モンテステリース有限会社 (Kyoto) in a renovated Kyoto machiya more than 100 years old, serving afternoon tea, seasonal parfaits and dessert courses; in April 2024 it ran a charity night opening and sold maqaw-pepper cookies in aid of disaster relief. Per Tabelog: plated desserts and afternoon tea by a skilled pâtissier.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: special sweets that highlight texture, temperature, aroma and appearance.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 walk-in checked in by smartphone with six groups ahead.
An August 2026 guest celebrating a friend’s birthday had the new peach afternoon tea.
An August 2026 visitor singled out the free-flow milk tea and kept reordering it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: プレスリリース (2023〜2024年): 京都烏丸の町家カフェ MAISON TANUKI、2023年5月開業、築100年超の京町家を改装したサロンスタイルのカフェ、アフタヌーンティー、季節のパフェ、スイーツコース、モンテステリース有限会社、2024年4月に馬告のクッキーサレと夜の特別営業の売上の一部を寄付。食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、中京区長浜町143-3、烏丸御池駅から256m、11:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、無休、チャージ料なし、60席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、インボイス T5130002022628 (モンテステリース有限会社)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 桃やシャインマスカットのアフタヌーンティーとフリードリンク、抹茶モンブラン、かぼちゃのブリュレバスクチーズケーキ、苺とピスタチオのかき氷、塩レモンミルクのかき氷1,900円、スマホで順番待ち。

cultural_comfort.note: Book afternoon tea ahead; smartphone waitlist for walk-ins.

kyoto_osteria_is_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Italian with pasta, fried dishes and sauces; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_osteria_is_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Wagyu and seafood lead the menu; nothing vegan is marked (reviews).
kyoto_osteria_is_gion.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order food 14:00, drinks 14:30); dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); open daily (Tabelog). No service or cover charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料、チャージ料0円いただいていません」). 24 seats: 8 at the counter and 16 at tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards including UnionPay, transit IC and other e-money, and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Hidden at the back of the SPACEしんばし building on Nawate-dori by Shinbashi in Gion, 266 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Formerly Youshoku Haru Gion (Tabelog). Operator エフ・シー・ジャパン株式会社, registered at this address (invoice).
kyoto_osteria_is_gion.notes: [Italian · Gion Nawate, wagyu bistecca by Shinbashi] A calm Italian room hidden at the back of a building on Nawate-dori by the Shinbashi bridge. The signature is a Kuroge wagyu bistecca; around it come seasonal antipasti, pastas and wine. Courses from ¥6,000, with all-you-can-drink options popular with groups before or after the Minami-za. No service or cover charge. Open daily, late.

roles: Chef not named; operator エフ・シー・ジャパン株式会社 (invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: Italian in the streets of Gion built around top-grade Kuroge wagyu bistecca and seasonal ingredients, paired with selected wines; formerly listed as Youshoku Haru Gion. The invoice holder エフ・シー・ジャパン株式会社 is registered at the restaurant’s address.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: dishes that bring out each ingredient’s own flavour.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 theatregoer came before Kabuki at Minami-za for the ¥8,500 Tabelog course with all-you-can-drink and wagyu bistecca.
An October 2026 party that had booked the wrong date was still given a table.
An August 2026 diner on the ¥6,500 drinks course found nothing memorable.

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to find inside the building; courses make ordering easy.

kyoto_yakiniku_nikushima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tare is brought even when not ordered (May 2026); marinated cuts and kimchi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_nikushima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku and offal house (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_nikushima.hours_raw: Tabelog: 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday. Booking advised — near full at peak (December 2025); Hot Pepper booking (May 2026). Ground floor 15 seats: a 6-seat counter and two small tables (for 2 and 4); the 2nd floor (25 seats, larger tables) is for members only, or reserved use by members (Tabelog; August 2026); members also get rooftop events (January 2026). Non-smoking; cards, no e-money. Opened 7 July 2015; moved and reopened 26 July 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_nikushima.notes: [Yakiniku · Karasuma-Marutamachi, fresh tongue by the station] A cosy, cramped yakiniku a minute from Marutamachi Station, prized for fresh tongue — as sashimi or grilled — and tender outside skirt at fair prices. The upstairs room is for members only. One group of four was squeezed by the cold entrance (March 2026); another diner tasted something like chemical seasoning in the broth (August 2026). Open till midnight; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 July 2015 and reopened at this address on 26 July 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a small ground floor of six counter seats and two little tables, an upstairs for members with larger tables, membership perks including rooftop events, and a crowd of locals.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "I wish they had told me there were no tables for four" — the group was seated at a cramped table by the entrance, "and it was freezing," and the group left before getting full.
August 2026: "there was something lingering in my mouth... (perhaps it was a chemical seasoning?) Especially noticeable in the broth."
January 2026: "It seems that if you become a member, there are special activities available on the rooftop."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉 にくしま、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、中京区烏丸通丸田町下る大倉町207-2、丸太町駅3番出口から徒歩約1分、17:30〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、水曜休み、15席 (2階25席は会員限定・会員の貸切利用)、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー不可、2015年7月7日オープン、2019年7月26日移転リニューアル。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 牛タンの盛り合わせとタン刺し、ネギ塩タン、特選ハラミ、特上ロース (特選部位でも2,000円以下)、上ミノの薄切り、レバー、ユッケ、ネギ付きのもも、チョレギサラダ、タコキムチ、おすすめコース、烏龍茶はおかわり自由、レモン50円、1階はカウンター6席と小さなテーブル2つ、会員は屋上のイベントも、4人で狭い入口の席で寒かったという声、化学調味料のような後味という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small local room; the upstairs is members-only (Tabelog).

kyoto_tearoom_toka.gf_detail: Ask: organic tea is the point; the sweets (chocolate, wagashi, cake) are not described for wheat (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_tearoom_toka.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options; teas are plant-based, sweets vary (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_tearoom_toka.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesday; hours may change. Booking via TableCheck — choose date, time, guests and course (March 2024; March 2025). 6 counter seats; shoes off at the entrance; no photographs in the tea room (2022–2025 reviews); non-smoking; English menu; children welcome; cards (Visa, JCB) and QR. No coffee or food — tea and sweets only; tea leaves and cocoa for sale (Tabelog).
kyoto_tearoom_toka.notes: [Tea room · east of the Imperial Palace, single-origin organic tea] A six-seat counter tea room inside the gallery nichinichi, in a Taisho-era house that was once a Nihonga painter’s home: smell a dozen single-origin organic teas from test tubes, then take each one brew by brew with a chocolate or wagashi. Book online; shoes off; no photos in the tea room. Allow about an hour. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Run by food director Fumie Okumura, per a June 2022 review
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2025 describe a tea room sharing a roughly 100-year-old Taisho-era house with the gallery nichinichi, once the home of the Nihonga painter Go Un Nishimura (June 2022), east of the Kyoto Imperial Palace; a June 2022 diner says it is owned by food director Fumie Okumura. Tea leaves, tea tools and cocoa are sold in the same space; the paper bag reads "tea is a work of art" (March 2024).
chef_bio.philosophy: From its shop bag (March 2024): "tea is a work of art."
chef_bio.specialty: Single-origin organic sencha tasted brew by brew.

anecdotes.text: March 2024: "This time, I chose from 13 types of tea. The tea leaves were presented in test tubes, allowing me to smell them before placing my order."
"No photography is allowed inside the tearoom. It’s a rule, so there’s nothing we can do about it, but it’s a shame." — March 2025.
December 2022: tea and sweets take time — "plan for about an hour… but it’s also fine to stay for over two hours if you wish."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: tearoom toka (冬夏)、カフェ・チョコレート、上京区信富町298 gallery nichinichi、神宮丸太町駅3番出口から徒歩約7分、京都御苑の南東角から徒歩約3分、11:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、火曜休み、カウンター6席、玄関で靴を脱ぐ、禁煙、英語メニュー、子供可、カード (VISA・JCB)・QR可、ベジタリアン対応、煎茶・焙じ茶・ハーブティーと菓子のセット、茶葉とカカオの販売、コーヒーと食事はなし。口コミ (2020年12月〜2025年3月、英語): フードディレクターの Fumie Okumura さんの店、大正時代の築約100年の家、日本画家 Go Un Nishimura の旧宅、TableCheck で予約、茶室内は撮影不可、試験管で香りを確かめて選ぶ約13種、和束のシングルオリジンの煎茶、宮崎五ヶ瀬の釜炒り茶、玉露、やぶきたのかぶせ、一煎目は少量の熱めの湯で、1茶1菓の「はじめ」コース、希少なカカオのチョコレート、生菓子、ケーキ+300円、「tea is a work of art」、1時間ほどかかる。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; online booking; shoes off; no photos in the tea room.

kyoto_com_ngon.gf_detail: Ask: pho and bun are rice noodles, but fried spring rolls, soy-based sauces and shrimp chips are shared kitchen items (2026 reviews).
kyoto_com_ngon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef and chicken broths, pork, shrimp, fish sauce (2026 reviews).
kyoto_com_ngon.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 22:00); open all year. Reservations through the official site. 40 seats including a counter and upstairs; non-smoking; children welcome; cards, e-money and QR. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「無し」. Opened 16 December 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_com_ngon.notes: [Vietnamese · Shijo-Karasuma, pho and bun cha lunches] A popular Vietnamese restaurant near Shijo-Karasuma since 2011, open every day: pho bo and pho ga, bun cha and bun bo Hue in lunch sets with spring rolls and salad, coriander on the side for the shy. One diner noted rising prices (November 2026); another found the bun bo Hue’s heat fixed and mild (August 2026). No service charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened 16 December 2011 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a quiet, popular lunch spot with many solo women diners, seats upstairs, Bat Trang pottery, welcoming staff, coriander served separately, and a lunch menu of about a dozen noodle and rice sets.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: the bun bo Hue was milder than promised; "I was informed that the spiciness of the broth couldn’t be adjusted," and the bottled chilli sauce changed the flavour instead.
A returning diner in November 2026: "It was obvious that prices have increased since my last visit."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ベトナム料理コムゴン 京都、ベトナム料理、中京区一蓮社町304、四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜15:30 (L.O. 15:00)・17:30〜22:30 (料理 L.O. 21:30、ドリンク L.O. 22:00)、年中無休、予約は公式サイトから、40席、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料は原文で「無し」、2011年12月16日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年11月、英語): フォーボーのセット (豚の甘辛煮のご飯、海老せんのサラダ)、フォーガー1,000円、ブンチャー1,100円・1,250円、ブンボーフエ、フーティウ、汁なしのフーティウコー と卵スープ、揚げ春巻と生春巻、パクチーは別皿、生唐辛子とライム、ランチは12種ほど、2階席、バッチャン焼きの器、女性の一人客が多い、値上がりしたという声、ブンボーフエの辛さは調整できないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Online booking; coriander on the side.

kyoto_manshige_porta.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried nama-fu (wheat gluten), nama-fu dengaku and soy-seasoned dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_manshige_porta.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi soups, sashimi, duck, fish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_manshige_porta.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00, closing days follow the Porta underground mall. No reservations — full by about 11:30 on a weekday (September 2026), so arrive at opening. Counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome; cards, transit IC, e-money and most QR. Branch of the Nishijin Kyoto-cuisine house 萬重 (26001533) in the Porta mall under Kyoto Station.
kyoto_manshige_porta.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Kyoto Station Porta, a Nishijin house’s station branch] The Porta-mall outpost of the Nishijin Kyoto-cuisine house Manshige: ¥2,200 bento of duck, sashimi, yuba and nama-fu, a yuba set, matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn, and a sake flight from Sasaki brewery — a calm Kyoto lunch under the station. No bookings; it fills by 11:30. One diner’s dessert bean paste had melted (September 2026).

roles: Not named in a source; a branch of 萬重, a long-established Nishijin Kyoto-cuisine house (October 2026 review; crawl)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm room with a counter in the Porta mall under Kyoto Station, staff who greet guests in Kyoto dialect, quick service and tea refills, and a mix of tourists, solo diners and local regulars; one local has known Manshige since childhood as the family’s place for gatherings and memorials (October 2026). The main restaurant, 萬重, is in Nishijin.

anecdotes.text: "I was also comforted by the staff’s warm greeting of 'O-koshi-yasu~' which is typical of Kyoto." — October 2026.
September 2026: "Unfortunately, the red bean paste in the dessert had melted, but the flavors of the dishes and the hospitality were great."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 萬重 ポルタ店、日本料理、下京区東塩小路町902 京都駅前地下街ポルタ内、京都駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:00〜22:00、休みはポルタに準じる、予約不可、カウンター席、禁煙、子供可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、公式サイトは京料理 萬重。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 萬重弁当2,200円 (鴨ロースの山椒、お造り、湯葉豆腐、生麩田楽、湯葉と麩のお吸い物)、京ゆば膳2,200円 (湯葉丼、湯葉サラダ)、織姫、西陣3,300円、秋の松茸の土瓶蒸し (+660円で変更)、湯葉の煮麺、京風の生麩の揚げ物4色、三色生麩田楽500円、佐々木酒造の飲み比べ (聚楽第)、西陣の老舗、京言葉の「おこしやす」、11時半には満席、デザートの餡が溶けていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; arrive at opening.

kyoto_tomato_san_shimabara.gf_detail: Not GF: curry roux, breaded cutlets and fritters, spaghetti and yakisoba (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tomato_san_shimabara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu mince curry, hamburg steak, chicken and shrimp dishes, omelettes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tomato_san_shimabara.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday–Sunday 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–20:30 (last order 19:30); closed Tuesday and Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; July 2024). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). The menu has varied: curry only for a time in 2024, set lunches again by 2025–2026 (2024–2026 reviews). A red-tomato noren on a white ground in the Shimabara shopping street, a 150-year-old building near the Kyoto Aquarium; about 500 m from Tanbaguchi Stn (Tabelog; January and October 2024).
kyoto_tomato_san_shimabara.notes: [Yoshoku · Shimabara, couple-run for over 40 years] A ten-seat counter under a red-tomato noren in old Shimabara, run by a cheerful couple who chat with every guest: crisp shrimp fritters and chicken cutlet, braised mini hamburgs, the cheese-in-hamburg omelette called the Spielberg, and a wagyu mince curry, all with a salad in homemade dressing. The menu shifts over time. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner couple (unnamed), together for over 40 years, formerly running a French restaurant (January 2024 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yoshoku counter in Shimabara. Reviewers in January 2024 describe a couple who previously owned a French restaurant and have run this place for over 40 years in a 150-year-old building; later reviewers note a curry-only period in 2024 and a broader lunch menu again by 2025–2026.

anecdotes.text: A January 2024 guest found everyone else at the counter was a regular chatting happily with the owner.
A July 2024 diner ordered the curry large for ¥200 more — and regretted it, the portion was so big.
A July 2024 returnee, back after over a decade, was served a homemade iced coffee after the ¥980 curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食、下京区二人司町2、Tanbaguchi 駅から486m、月・木〜日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O.13:30)・17:00〜20:30 (L.O.19:30)、火・水定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、10席、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年3月、英語): 島原、京都水族館の近く、白地に赤いトマトののれん、築150年の建物、元フレンチの店の夫婦が40年以上営む、手作りドレッシングのサラダ、ランチ1,000〜1,700円、スペシャルランチ1,300円 (海老フリッターとチキンカツ)、煮込みハンバーグ1,200円、照り焼きチキン1,000円、ハンバーグと海老フライとだし巻き、チーズ入りハンバーグのオムレツ「Spielberg」、カレー980円 (和牛ミンチ、焼きチキン、海老)、大盛り+200円、自家製アイスコーヒー、スパゲティと焼きそば、一時はカレーのみ、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter only; friendly owners; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; latest review March 2026.

kyoto_gourmand_tachibana_rihga.gf_detail: Ask. Courses of French dishes with Japanese ingredients and tea, plus walnut bread, cutlets and desserts; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gourmand_tachibana_rihga.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of salmon, sea bream, Tanba chicken and pork, wagyu, foie gras and eel (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gourmand_tachibana_rihga.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 12:00–15:30 and 17:00–21:30; Saturday–Sunday 11:30–15:30 and 17:00–21:30; last orders 14:30 and 20:00; irregular closing days, see the hotel website (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online too (Tabelog; May 2026). A 15% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料１5％). Courses such as Miyako, Mai, Tokyo and Tachibana at lunch from about ¥5,000, with member prices (2025–2026 reviews). 28 seats, mainly a counter facing the chef, and private rooms for 4–30 (fee) (Tabelog; May 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). B1F of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto; hotel parking free for 3 hours with a ¥4,000 spend from 1 April 2026; 7 min walk west of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_gourmand_tachibana_rihga.notes: [Kaiseki French · RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto B1F] A counter of French cooking in kaiseki rhythm at the RIHGA Royal near Kyoto Station: seasonal Japanese ingredients and tea woven into salmon tartare, chestnut-stuffed shiitake, sea bream and wagyu, with good-value lunch courses and a sommelier-led wine pairing at dinner. Private rooms suit family occasions. Plus 15% service. Hotel parking deal.

roles: Hotel kitchen at the counter (chef unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the kaiseki-style French restaurant of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto; registered as an official listing by the operator. An April 2026 reviewer recalls monthly wine events here over ten years ago hosted by sommelier Yoshinaga, who has since moved up but still served as sommelier that night, and notes the chef has changed since then.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto ingredients with the richness of French cuisine (April 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 couple, celebrating the second of two yearly anniversaries, received complimentary ice cream and flowers.
In September 2025 a family chose a private room here for the formal meeting of both sides before a wedding.
An April 2026 guest, back after a decade, was served by sommelier Yoshinaga, who had hosted monthly wine evenings years before.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・洋食、下京区松明町1 リーガロイヤルホテル京都 B1F、JR京都駅から西へ徒歩約7分、月〜金 12:00〜15:30・17:00〜21:30、土日 11:30〜15:30・17:00〜21:30 (L.O.14:30・20:00)、不定休、予約可、サービス料15%、28席、個室 (4〜30名、別料金)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、ホテルの駐車場は2026年4月1日から4,000円以上の利用で3時間無料。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年9月、英語): カウンターが中心、日本の食材とお茶を使うフレンチ、ランチのコース (Miyako、Mai、Tokyo、Tachibana など) 5,000円ほどから、会員価格、和牛のサーロインやフィレへの変更、サーモンのタルタルとセロリアックのムース、鶏と栗の椎茸、鯛の白ワインときのこのソース、ブダイ、モッツァレラのとんかつ、Tanba の豚の大葉とチーズ巻き、夜はワインペアリング、鰻とフォアグラ、まながつおの燻製、胡桃のパンとほうじ茶バター、5種のデザート、ソムリエの Yoshinaga さん、両家の顔合わせ、記念日のサービス。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; book online; 15% service; cards, IC and QR.

kyoto_okutan_kiyomizu.gf_detail: Ask. Yudofu in kombu water is simple, but the dipping sauce is soy-based and the set includes tempura and miso dengaku; ramen is served from 14:30 (2026 reviews).
kyoto_okutan_kiyomizu.vegan_detail: Ask. The set is tofu, sesame tofu, dengaku, tempura and tororo with a kombu broth, but the dipping sauce's base is not stated and no vegan information is given (2026 reviews).
kyoto_okutan_kiyomizu.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday 11:00–16:00; Saturday–Sunday 11:00–17:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised at weekends (Tabelog; October 2026). Ramen from 14:30 (September 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; March and August 2026). 120 seats on tatami, shoes off, with private rooms facing the garden; designated smoking area (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the approach to Kiyomizu-dera, Kiyomizu 3-chome; about 15 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_okutan_kiyomizu.notes: [Yudofu · on the slope to Kiyomizu-dera, garden rooms] A historic tofu house on the Kiyomizu approach, calm inside despite the crowds: a set of silky yudofu in kombu broth with sesame tofu, dengaku, tempura and tororo for ¥4,400, or a firmer old-style tofu for ¥5,500, eaten on tatami with views of the garden — glorious in cherry and maple seasons. Some find it pricey for what it is. Cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tofu and Japanese-cuisine restaurant near Kiyomizu-dera with tatami and private rooms; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established yudofu restaurant in a historic building with a well-kept garden; a March 2026 reviewer was told one private room has been visited by the Emperor.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 party of three generations was shown to a private room said to have been visited by the Emperor.
A September 2026 repeat visitor was surprised to find ramen served from 14:30.
A May 2026 guest found the food underwhelming for ¥4,400 with no dessert, and the new ramen out of keeping with a yudofu house.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豆腐料理・日本料理、東山区清水3-340、祇園四条駅1番出口から徒歩約15分、月〜水・金 11:00〜16:00、土日 11:00〜17:00、木曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、120席、座敷、個室、分煙、テイクアウト、日本酒にこだわる。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 清水寺の参道、歴史ある建物、庭、靴を脱ぐ、「Okimari」のセット4,400円 (絹ごしの湯豆腐、昆布だし、胡麻豆腐、田楽、天ぷら、とろろ)、「Mukashi tofu」のセット5,500円 (固めの豆腐)、14時半からラーメン、現金のみ、週末は予約がおすすめ、天皇が訪れた個室という話 (2026年3月)、割高との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off, tatami; set courses; book at weekends; cash only.

kyoto_le_temps_granvia.gf_detail: Ask. A large buffet of Japanese and Western dishes, cakes and breads; ask staff about ingredients; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_le_temps_granvia.vegan_detail: Ask. A shojin (vegetarian) tempura with tororo soup was served in October 2026, and Kyoto vegetables appear at breakfast, but most of the buffet uses meat, fish, eggs and dairy (2026 reviews).
kyoto_le_temps_granvia.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and around holidays 6:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); Friday–Sunday and holidays 6:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); open year-round; from 7 May to 31 August 2026, 6:30–22:00 daily with dinner buffets of 120 minutes (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; holiday prices differ (Tabelog). A 15% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料15％). Lunch buffet 90 minutes (September 2026). 164 seats (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 2F of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, right of the JR Kyoto Station central gate; 2 hours' parking at the station building east car park with a meal (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_le_temps_granvia.notes: [Hotel buffet · Hotel Granvia, inside Kyoto Station] The bright, roomy buffet café of the Granvia over Kyoto Station: a lavish breakfast with omelettes to order and roast wagyu from 6:30, Japanese and Western buffets at lunch and dinner, seasonal sweets buffets, and cakes for a quiet tea. Busy at opening; one guest found drink service slow. Plus 15% service. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the café restaurant of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, directly connected to JR Kyoto Station; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a popular buffet with many overseas guests, a line at the 6:30 opening (September 2026), and a live kitchen for omelettes (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor arriving at the 6:30 opening found about ten people already in line.
An October 2026 guest choosing between this and the Hilton buffet came here for the reviews, and found the meat and tempura strong but the drink service slow.
A September 2026 diner with food allergies had to pick carefully across the buffet.

"I found it really unpleasant when some foreign guests pushed in from the side and placed the tongs in different spots right in front of me. I noticed the staff had to address this issue repeatedly" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビュッフェ・カフェ・ケーキ、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル JR京都駅中央口 ホテルグランヴィア京都 2F、JR京都駅中央改札の右、月〜木・祝前日・祝翌日 6:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、金土日祝 6:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、無休、2026年5月7日〜8月31日は6:30〜22:00、ディナーブッフェは120分制、予約可、年末年始は料金が変わる、サービス料15%、164席、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 京野菜の焼き物、おばんざい、鯛茶漬け、黒毛和牛のロースト、ハッシュドポテト、5種から選べるオムレツ、寿司、天ぷら、ローストビーフ、ピザ、パスタ、カレー、焼売、季節のスイーツブッフェ (秋、ハロウィン)、ショーケースのケーキでカフェ利用、ケーキの持ち帰り、精進天ぷらととろろ汁、ランチは90分、朝6時半から行列、外国人客が多い、駐車場2時間無料、ドリンクが遅いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel buffet; book ahead at weekends; 15% service; cards, IC and QR.

kyoto_ryosen.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi and soy-seasoned dishes, a kombu soy for sashimi, mapo tofu and pasta at lunch (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_ryosen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cooking built on dashi, with mackerel, eel, beef and chicken. The course has included a vegan tom yum soup (September and October 2026), so ask.
kyoto_ryosen.hours_raw: Lunch Tue–Fri 11:30–13:30, no lunch reservations; dinner Mon–Fri 18:00–22:00, Sat, holidays and the days before and after holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday, and dinner is closed on the 1st and 3rd Monday; may close early when food runs out (Tabelog). Dinner is hard to book — reserve through the website, Ikkyu or Instagram (March and June 2026); call for parties of 5 or more (Tabelog). Tabelog’s reservation notes say ¥200 is added to the course fee as a service charge. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: tables for 8, a counter for 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children 10 and over only (Tabelog). Dish photos may not be posted on social media (September 2026). In a townhouse on Oshikoji west of Muromachi, behind the Kyoto International Manga Museum; 225 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 November 2004 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryosen.notes: [Small kitchen · Karasuma Oike, the actor’s Kyoto favourite] A townhouse restaurant behind the Manga Museum where the owner explains every dashi: simmered mackerel, kanpachi with kombu soy, mapo tofu and a vegan tom yum on a course of about ¥9,000. Long a favourite of the actor Yutaka Matsushige, who brought it to a Netflix series, so dinner is hard to book; weekday lunch (oyakodon, curry) is walk-in. Over-10s only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who explains the dashi at the table (March 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (shop text): a small restaurant in a townhouse on Oshikoji Muromachi, open since 2004, prizing its simmered dishes and seasonal cooking with sake and wine. Reviews from February–October 2026 say it is a long-time favourite of the actor 松重豊 (Yutaka Matsushige), who featured it on a Netflix series; a June 2026 review says the actor has been coming since the owner’s mother ran a small restaurant called "Ichiraku".

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 couple was served a dashi vegetable soup while the owner explained how the dashi is made.
A September 2026 diner asked about social media and was told the menu may be posted but not the dishes; the vegan tom yum, made after much trial and error, impressed.
An eighth-visit regular in September 2026 brought colleagues and finally got the simmered dish again; in July the same regular had a Doyo-no-Ushi eel bento.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、中京区室町通押小路西入ル蛸薬師町293、烏丸御池駅から225m、昼 火〜金11:30〜13:30 (予約不可)、夜 月〜金18:00〜22:00・土祝17:00〜22:00、日曜休み、夜は第1・第3月曜休み、予約はコース料金に200円のサービス料 (英訳)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、14席、禁煙、10歳以上、2004年11月25日オープン、炊き物と季節の料理、日本酒とワイン。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 松重豊が長年通う店、Netflix の番組、Netflix コース約9,000円 (鶏と野菜のスープ、カンパチの刺身と昆布醤油、看板の煮込み、いかのよもぎ味噌、ヴィーガンのトムヤム、鰻、牛肉、麻婆豆腐、鯖の煮付け)、鯖煮、昼の親子丼やカレー、出汁を説明する店主、料理の写真の SNS 投稿は不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Book dinner well ahead online or via Instagram; lunch is walk-in on weekdays; children 10 and over. No English evidence found.

kyoto_restaurant_shin.gf_detail: Ask. French courses opening with a mini burger, with sauces, mousses and plated desserts (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_restaurant_shin.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led courses from contracted Kyoto farms, but fish and meat mains and dairy desserts (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_restaurant_shin.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 18:00–21:00; closed Monday; open over New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and dinner can be hard to book (Tabelog; May 2025). No service or cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料、チャージ料なし」). Cards, Rakuten Edy and QR (Tabelog). 12 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Children, a kids menu and strollers welcome (Tabelog). In a machiya-style room on Teramachi south of Takeyamachi, near the Imperial Palace; 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 18 July 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_restaurant_shin.notes: [French · Teramachi by the Imperial Palace, a couple’s 12-seat room] A warm little French restaurant in a white-and-wood machiya, run by a couple, cooking pesticide-free vegetables from Sonobe farms into colourful courses — a mini-burger amuse, sakura-shrimp mousse, a melting white-chocolate dessert. Lunch and dinner courses suit anniversaries; children welcome. Closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), running the restaurant with a partner as a couple (April 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: not a high-end image of French dining but a warm, comfortable French restaurant full of the chef’s care for ingredients, flavour and hospitality. Per Tabelog: opened 18 July 2011. An October 2026 review notes pesticide-free vegetables from contracted farms in Sonobe; an April 2026 review describes it as run by a couple.
chef_bio.philosophy: Special encounters through ingredients, flavour and hospitality (official site).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 couple celebrated a wedding anniversary at a place passed many times without realising it was French.
A March 2026 party arrived very late, and the staff stayed calm and even arranged caffeine-free drinks.
A May 2025 family found out only afterwards that it is hard to book, and enjoyed every dish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 高級フレンチのイメージではなく、素材、味、おもてなしにシェフの想いがあふれる温かく心地よいフレンチ。食べログ: フレンチ・ヨーロッパ料理・野菜料理、中京区寺町竹屋町下る久遠院前町667-1、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩8分、昼11:30〜14:30・夜18:00〜21:00、月曜休み、予約可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、カード・楽天Edy・QR 可、12席、禁煙、子供可・キッズメニュー、2011年7月18日オープン、京都の採れたての有機野菜。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): ミニバーガーのアミューズ、魚と肉のダブルメインの昼のコース、記念日コース、桜海老のムースと魚とムール貝、ラタトゥイユ、白いチョコレートが溶けるデザート、園部の契約農家の無農薬野菜、夫婦で営む、予約が取りにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a lunch or dinner course; family-friendly with a kids menu. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_pontocho_fumiya.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with tofu and yuba dishes, hamo and ayu, soy-based broths (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_pontocho_fumiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based Kyoto cooking with hamo, ayu, sashimi and beef; even the soy-milk yuba hot pot comes in a course (2026 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_fumiya.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); open daily May–September, irregular closures October–April; open over New Year (Tabelog; official site). Kawadoko (river-terrace) seating from 1 May, moved indoors in rain (official site). Reservations by phone or online; the cheapest course is often the Tabelog plan (September 2026). Service charge 10% at dinner, none at lunch, and no kawadoko seat charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「ディナー:10% ランチ:なし 共に床席料は頂いておりません。」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 40 seats with private rooms; smoking in the courtyard only (Tabelog). Two doors south of the Pontocho Kaburenjo on the Shijo side; 5 min from Sanjo, Gion-Shijo and Kawaramachi Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_fumiya.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, yuba and hamo by the Kamo River] An old Pontocho house next to the Kaburenjo with a summer kawadoko and window rooms over the Kamo River: yuba hot pot, hamo shabu-shabu, grilled ayu and Kyoto kaiseki, from about ¥5,000 at lunch. Reviews are mixed — the setting wins, but some September 2026 diners found insects on the terrace, little hamo and patchy service. 10% service at dinner only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Pontocho Kyoto-cuisine restaurant with a summer kawadoko, open over New Year, which notes on its site a 75th anniversary (year not stated). Per Tabelog: Kyoto cuisine and tofu dishes, two doors south of the Pontocho Kaburenjo.
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba hot pot; hamo dishes; kawadoko dining.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor was led to a private second-floor room with the Kamo River right in front for a hamo lunch.
A September 2026 diner asked to move indoors because of insects on the terrace, and found little hamo in a hamo course.
An August 2026 diner watched the staff mop the terrace dry when the rain stopped so the kawadoko could open.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都 先斗町 富美家 (川床・納涼床)、5月1日から納涼川床、雨天は店内、年末年始も営業、75周年 (年の記載なし)、ネットと電話で予約。食べログ: 日本料理・豆腐料理、中京区先斗町歌舞練場南隣2軒目、三条駅などから徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00・夜17:00〜23:00、5〜9月は無休、10〜4月は不定休、予約可、ディナーはサービス料10%、ランチはなし、床席料なし、カード可、40席、個室、喫煙は中庭。口コミ (2026年3月〜9月、英語): 豆乳湯葉鍋の昼のセット5,500円、鱧のしゃぶしゃぶ、焼いた鮎、川床のコース、日本酒3種の飲み比べ、食べログ予約の8,800円のコース、鴨川の眺め、虫や鱧が少ないとの不満も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course (the kawadoko in season); ask for a river-view room. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_pontocho_shiki_yoshina.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style kaiseki with tofu, yuba, dengaku and obanzai (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_pontocho_shiki_yoshina.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based kaiseki with hamo, ayu and fish (2026 reviews); tofu and yuba dishes are part of courses.
kyoto_pontocho_shiki_yoshina.hours_raw: BOOKINGS FROM OUTSIDE JAPAN ARE NOT ACCEPTED. The official site says: 「日本国外からまたはホテルの電話番号や直接ご連絡の取れないお電話番号、メールアドレスでのご予約は出来ません。日本語のみ対応可」 — no reservations from outside Japan, or from hotel phone numbers or numbers and emails that cannot be reached directly; Japanese only. Dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:15); special lunches 12:30–14:30 on set days, for 4 or more, courses only, booked 3 days ahead; closed irregularly — see the official site (Tabelog; official site). Phone bookings 13:00–15:00 (Tabelog). Kaiseki and the winter hot-pot course need booking 3 days ahead (official site). Seat requests (river view, private room for two, terrace position) are not taken (Tabelog). Kawadoko from May to 15 October, indoors in bad weather (Tabelog). Service charge 5%, included in course prices (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料５％頂いております。※コース料金には含まれております。」). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 60 seats: counter, tables, private rooms, an 11-seat kawadoko (Tabelog). Entirely non-smoking; children under 10 by arrangement (Tabelog). Fourth house past Pontocho Park toward Sanjo, river side; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_shiki_yoshina.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Pontocho, tofu and a river terrace — no bookings from outside Japan] A Pontocho house with a live-kitchen counter, private rooms and a kawadoko over the Kamo River, serving monthly Kyoto kaiseki, tofu and yuba dishes and a winter hot pot. The official site states that it does not accept reservations from outside Japan or from hotel phone numbers, and handles bookings in Japanese only. Dinner from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: a Pontocho Kyoto-cuisine restaurant with a kawadoko, monthly Kyoto-style kaiseki and a winter hot-pot course; it does not take reservations from outside Japan or from hotel phone numbers, and bookings are in Japanese only.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner enjoyed the stylish chef’s live cooking at the counter and found the prices reasonable for the setting.
A September 2026 group caught in rain on the terrace were quickly brought umbrellas by the staff, and the rain soon stopped.
A September 2026 party had a seating mix-up on a kawadoko booking, and the staff moved the party to the terrace.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京風会席 (月替わり、3日前までに予約)、冬季限定のお鍋のコース、日にち限定の昼の特別営業 (4名から、コースのみ、3日前までに予約)、日本国外からまたはホテルの電話番号や直接連絡の取れない電話番号・メールアドレスでの予約は不可、日本語のみ対応。食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区先斗町通三条下ル2若松町141-1、三条駅から徒歩約5分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:15)、昼12:30〜14:30 (予約のみ)、不定休、電話予約は13:00〜15:00、席の指定不可、川床は5月〜10月15日、サービス料5% (コース料金に含む)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、60席 (川床11席)、全面禁煙、10歳未満は要相談。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 鱧、鮎、田楽の季節のコース、豆腐、湯葉、おばんざい、目の前で料理するカウンター、川床、雨の日に傘を出してくれた。

cultural_comfort.note: The shop does not accept bookings from outside Japan or from hotel phone numbers, and handles reservations in Japanese only (official site) — book from a Japanese phone number, in Japanese, between 13:00 and 15:00.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_raamen_hiryuu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen, tsukemen and mazesoba noodles with soy-based tare (2026 reviews).
kyoto_raamen_hiryuu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, pork and shellfish broths (2026 reviews).
kyoto_raamen_hiryuu.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30); night 18:00–01:30 (last order 01:00); closed irregularly — check its social media; New Year 2026–27: evening of 31 December only, closed 1–2 January, normal from the 3rd (Tabelog). Order by QR code or ticket (January and April 2026). Cash only per Tabelog. No service charge listed (Tabelog). 7 seats at a U-shaped counter in a small, hut-like room; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). 381 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 22 May 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_raamen_hiryuu.notes: [Ramen · Marutamachi, a seven-seat counter open till 1:30] A tiny U-shaped ramen counter west of Jingu-Marutamachi that keeps going until 1:30 a.m. — a favourite after a night out. The shoyu bowls lean on shellfish broth; the 'Flying Dragon' mazesoba and spicy tsukemen have fans too. Bowls about ¥1,000; order by QR code. Cash only; closed irregularly.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 22 May 2021; ramen made with carefully selected ingredients. A January 2026 reviewer notes the shop’s stance on minimal chemical seasonings.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: healthy, delicious and fun.
chef_bio.specialty: Shellfish-broth shoyu ramen; Flying Dragon mazesoba.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor came straight from bar-hopping for the chuka soba.
A September 2026 diner ordered the Flying Dragon mazesoba and changed it up with the table condiments.
An October 2026 visitor found a cosy, hut-like room with a U-shaped counter and mostly overseas guests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らぁめん飛瀧、ラーメン・そば・中華、中京区大文字町234、神宮丸太町駅から381m、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)、18:00〜翌1:30 (L.O. 1:00)、不定休 (SNS で告知)、年末年始は31日の夜のみ・1月1〜2日休み・3日から通常、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター7席、禁煙、2021年5月22日オープン、公式紹介: 健康で美味しく楽しい、こだわりの食材。口コミ (2026年、英語): 化学調味料を控えめに、QR コードで注文、貝出汁の鶏白湯醤油、「おかげさまで魚介」醤油、中華そば、鶏豚白湯1,000円、辛いつけ麺、まぜそば「飛瀧」、U字カウンター、海外からの客。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with 2026–27 New Year hours; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_sumiyaki_torikou.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori with salt or tare and fried chicken; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_sumiyaki_torikou.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori house (official site).
kyoto_sumiyaki_torikou.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and the 1st and 3rd Monday (Tabelog). Very busy — book or call ahead; walk-ins sometimes fit in late (2026 reviews). Bookings up to 12 people (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats in a renovated machiya with a tsuboniwa courtyard garden; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog; official site). On Sanjo-dori west of Karasuma, about 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened 15 July 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumiyaki_torikou.notes: [Yakitori · Sanjo west of Karasuma, binchotan skewers in a machiya] A stylish yakitori house in a renovated townhouse with a little courtyard garden, grilling brand chickens like Kyo-akaji-dori over Kishu binchotan until midnight. Start with the omakase of five skewers, then add rarer cuts — furisode, fundoshi, heart. Good value and always busy, so call ahead. Closed Sunday and the 1st and 3rd Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a yakitori house facing Sanjo-dori in a renovated Kyoto machiya, using morning-slaughtered brand chickens such as 京赤地どり and 丹波あじわいどり, grilled over Kishu binchotan with a mellow roasted salt and house tare. Tabelog gives the opening as 15 July 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "今宵も幸せ焼き鳥時間" — another happy yakitori evening.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular on a fifth visit was lucky to get a same-day booking.
An October 2026 visitor dropped in after a meeting, explained the time limit, and was squeezed in.
An August 2026 diner had tried for a while — it was always full, with a queue outside — before finally getting in.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (torikou.net): 炭焼 とり幸 (すみやき とりこう)、三条通に面した京町家を改装した焼き鳥屋、京赤地どりや丹波あじわいどりなどのブランド鶏の朝びき、紀州備長炭、角のない焼き塩とタレ、予約は12名まで、今宵も幸せ焼き鳥時間。食べログ: 焼き鳥・居酒屋、中京区塩屋町47-2、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月〜土17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、日曜・第1第3月曜休み、20席、禁煙、カード可、2021年7月15日オープン、坪庭。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): いつも混む、おまかせ5本、ハツ、ふりそで、ぼんじり、ふんどし、皮、ねぎま、唐揚げ、キャベツの味噌。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; it fills every night.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.
