kyoto_pageone_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Shaved ice with fruit, milk and matcha syrups, plus bar food and cocktails; no gluten information is published (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_pageone_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit syrups over ice, but several bowls use milk; nothing vegan is marked (2025 reviews).
kyoto_pageone_gion.hours_raw: 13:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). From 18:00 "bar time": a ¥300 table charge per person (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「BAR time(18:00)より､お一人様テーブルチャージ\300.-」); reservations taken for bar time only (official site). JCB and AMEX; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter and sofa seating; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Shimogawara-dori just south of Yasaka Shrine’s south gate, about 12 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site).
kyoto_pageone_gion.notes: [Sweets & bar · Gion Shimogawara, kakigori in a bowl of ice] The café-bar of 森田氷室本店, Kyoto's oldest ice maker, just south of Yasaka Shrine. Its crystal-clear ice, frozen over 72 hours, is shaved into kakigori — Uji kintoki, fresh strawberry, squeezed orange — and served in bowls carved from the ice itself, all year round. From 18:00 it becomes a cocktail bar with a ¥300 table charge. Open till midnight; closed Wednesday.

roles: Run by the fifth-generation brothers of 森田氷室本店 (official site); not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 森田氷室本店, in its 133rd year and Kyoto’s oldest ice maker, freezes purified water for more than 72 hours for hard, clear ice; page one was started by the brothers of the fifth generation to add a new page to that history, serving ice in hand-carved ice bowls; featured on many TV programmes since 2013.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: good ice is enjoyed three times — with the eyes, the ears and the mouth.
chef_bio.specialty: Kakigori in a carved ice bowl.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 passer-by stepped into what looked like a stylish bar and found it full of overseas visitors.
A September 2024 visitor noticed the ice in the ice bowl hardly melted over time.
An August 2025 guest during Obon walked straight in and found the ice-bowl portion bigger than it looked.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (pageone-gion.com): PAGE ONE、カフェ＆ダイニングバー、京都祇園下河原、美味しい氷は目で耳で口で三度味わえる、不純物を取り除き72時間以上かけて凍らせる、森田氷室本店は133年目で京都最古参の氷屋、五代目の兄弟で立ち上げた店、氷塊を手作業で削った器、東山区下河原通八坂鳥居前下る上弁天町435-4、祇園四条駅から徒歩12分、13:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、水曜定休、Bar time のみ予約可、テレビ出演多数 (2013年〜)。食べログ: カフェ・サンド・かき氷、BAR time (18:00) からテーブルチャージ300円、カード (JCB・AMEX)。口コミ (2024〜2025年、英語): 氷の器、宇治金時1,500円、宇治1,400円 (夜は+300円)、生いちご1,200円、生搾りオレンジ、レモン、カクテル900円〜、生ビール850円、海外からの客。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors; bar-time bookings only.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; most recent review September 2025.

kyoto_grand_jour_granvia.gf_detail: Ask. Cakes, sandwiches, omurice and parfaits; the lounge follows labelling for the eight specified allergens including wheat and asks guests to tell staff on the day (Tabelog).
kyoto_grand_jour_granvia.vegan_detail: Ask. Cakes and light meals with dairy and egg; nothing vegan is marked (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_grand_jour_granvia.hours_raw: 9:00–20:00 daily (last order 19:30); open all year; extended hours at peak periods, e.g. 31 October–6 December 2026 (hotel site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料15％」). Smart casual; men are asked not to wear sleeveless tops or sandals (Tabelog). 90–92 seats; cards and e-money (hotel site; Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of Hotel Granvia Kyoto inside JR Kyoto Station (central exit), with windows over the station concourse (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_grand_jour_granvia.notes: [Café · Kyoto Station, the Granvia's lobby lounge] The spacious lobby lounge of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, one floor above the station's central concourse — a calm place to wait for a train. Cakes such as the matcha Mont Blanc tart (about ¥1,400, ¥1,000 more with a drink), sandwiches, omurice and summer kakigori. No bookings; 15% service. Smart casual. Open daily 9:00–20:00.

roles: Hotel lounge of Hotel Granvia Kyoto; staff not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a spacious, open lounge next to the lobby of Hotel Granvia Kyoto with a view of Kyoto Station through the glass. The hotel’s other restaurants (for example View & Dining Kotoshie-ru and 京林泉) are separate records.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a tenth visit found some cakes sold out by 15:00 and had the Mont Blanc and grape cake.
An April 2026 group of six arriving at 15:30 found it nearly full and waited briefly at the entrance.
A May 2026 visitor used it to wait for the Shinkansen, watching the concourse below.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ホテルグランヴィア京都 公式サイト: ロビーラウンジ グランジュール、90席、10月31日〜12月6日は営業時間拡大。食べログ: カフェ・バー・ケーキ、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル JR京都駅中央口 ホテルグランヴィア京都2F、京都駅から73m、9:00〜20:00 (L.O. 19:30)、年中無休、特定原材料8品目のアレルギー表示 (当日申し出)、スマートカジュアル (男性のノースリーブ・サンダルは不可)、予約不可、各種割引対象外、サービス料15%、92席、カード・電子マネー可。公式紹介: ロビーに面した開放的なラウンジ、ガラス越しに京都駅。口コミ (2026年、英語): 抹茶モンブランタルト1,400円、フルーツロールケーキ1,400円、ドリンク+1,000円、ミックスサンド1,900円、アイスティー1,100円、抹茶・ほうじ茶のかき氷2,000円、カフェオレ1,200円、オムライス。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel lounge in Kyoto Station; no bookings.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The lounge follows labelling for the eight specified allergens (egg, milk, wheat, buckwheat, peanut, shrimp, crab, walnut) and asks guests to say on the day.

existence.note: Hotel website (hours notice for October–December 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kozara_ryori_38_shichijo.gf_detail: Ask. Small plates of fish and obanzai — sashimi, simmered dishes, fried dishes, grilled sweetfish, Kamo eggplant dengaku, beef tongue, sushi; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kozara_ryori_38_shichijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya; obanzai and simmered dishes use dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kozara_ryori_38_shichijo.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and holidays 17:00–22:30; Friday–Sunday also lunch 12:00–14:00; L.O. 21:30 (Tabelog). Two-hour seating on weekdays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, same-day too; often full (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Otoshi ¥500 (Tabelog, original お通し代500円(税込)). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Counter and tables; tablet ordering since 2026 (July 2026). On Shichijo south of Takakura, 5 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_kozara_ryori_38_shichijo.notes: [Fish izakaya · Shichijo-Takakura, near Kyoto Station] A lively counter-and-table izakaya a short walk from Kyoto Station: plump sashimi, sardines, grilled ayu and hamo in season, obanzai and Kamo eggplant dengaku, sushi and a strong sake list, with ¥500 shaved ice in summer. Usually busy; book, even same-day. ¥500 otoshi.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T8810755440012 is registered to the individual 澤井 俊秀 (NTA register); the Tabelog English name is “sawa”. Reviewers watch several chefs at work from the counter (August 2026); one found the food slow to come and the counter lighting shadowy (July–August 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner’s friends from the countryside were delighted by the obanzai.
A guest at a nearby hotel found it on the spot and liked the tuna, sea bream, sea urchin and hamo (August 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 小皿料理 38 (英語名 sawa)、居酒屋・日本料理・魚介、下京区七条高倉下がる小稲荷町22、京都駅から徒歩5分、月〜木・祝 17:00〜22:30、金〜日は昼12:00〜14:00も、L.O.21:30、平日は2時間制、予約可、お通し代500円、カード・PayPay可、適格請求書 T8810755440012 (澤井 俊秀)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 刺身の盛り合わせ (鮪、鯛、うに、鱧)、いわしの刺身、おばんざい、若竹煮、鮎の塩焼き、赤海老と帆立の焼き物、Kamo なすの田楽、牛タン、寿司、夏は500円のかき氷、タブレット注文、料理が出るのが遅いとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Tablet ordering; counter for solo diners; ¥500 otoshi.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_tokiwa_udon_kumano.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon (also soba and Chinese noodles) in a sweet Kyoto dashi, tempura udon, nama-fu on the shippoku udon (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tokiwa_udon_kumano.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based broths, kamaboko, egg and meat donburi (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tokiwa_udon_kumano.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog; hours may change — check). Reviewers found it open around 17:30 (March 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 18 seats; non-smoking; coin parking nearby (Tabelog). At the south-east corner of Kyoto University Hospital, opposite Kumano Shrine at Higashioji-Marutamachi, about 550 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_tokiwa_udon_kumano.notes: [Udon · opposite Kumano Shrine, a Showa noodle shop] A retro neighbourhood udon shop at the corner of Kyoto University Hospital: soft Kyoto udon in sweet dashi — shippoku, kitsune, tempura, nabe-yaki — with mini tamago-don sets and oyakodon, mostly ¥800–1,300. Cash only; closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. Reviewers describe a long-established, Showa-era shop with friendly staff (2025–2026).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor came for lunch after a check-up at Kyoto University Hospital next door.
A March 2026 visitor, planning only a rice ball before a live show, was greeted with “We’re open!” and stayed for kitsune udon.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ときわ、うどん・食堂、左京区聖護院山王町43、神宮丸太町駅から553m、11:00〜18:00、火曜定休 (最新の営業時間は要確認)、予約不可、現金のみ、18席、禁煙。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 熊野神社前、京大病院の南東の角、昭和の老舗、やわらかいうどんとほんのり甘い京都の出汁、しっぽくうどん780円 (蒲鉾2種、生麩、湯葉、ほうれん草、椎茸)、天ぷらうどんとミニ玉子丼1,150円、きつねうどん、鍋焼きうどん、親子丼、肉カレー丼1,000円、肉丼とミニうどん1,300円、夏はそうめん、そばや中華そばも。

cultural_comfort.note: Old neighbourhood noodle shop; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through April 2026.

kyoto_shunsai_adachi.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese set meals — grilled and simmered fish, dashimaki, yudofu, obanzai — but fried oysters, tonkatsu and vegetable tempura sets contain wheat; no gluten information (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shunsai_adachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable tempura and yudofu sets are offered, but the dashi, sake-lees soup and miso soup are not described (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_shunsai_adachi.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 17:00–21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog; hours may change). Set meals at dinner at lunch prices (April 2024; March 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 10 at the counter, 10 at tables; smoking area (Tabelog). About 100 m north of the Kawaramachi-Marutamachi crossing, 4 min from the Kawaramachi-Marutamachi bus stop and 6 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2023).
kyoto_shunsai_adachi.notes: [Set meals · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, home cooking at lunch prices] A counter-and-table Japanese kitchen just north of Kawaramachi-Marutamachi serving honest teishoku — simmered flounder, grilled saury or sardine, fried oysters, dashimaki, yudofu in winter — with obanzai picked from the counter, at about ¥1,000–1,500 day and night. The chef looks stern but is friendly.

chef_bio.background: An April 2024 reviewer describes a chef with a stern expression who is nonetheless friendly; the restaurant serves dinner set meals at lunch prices. A March 2025 diner valued the orthodox, homemade cooking.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, drawn in by the smell of grilling fish, was pleased the saury set price had not risen despite costly saury.
A February 2025 diner watched the year’s first fried oysters being fried right in front of the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旬菜 あだち、日本料理、上京区上生洲町247、市バス河原町丸太町から徒歩4分、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩6分、昼12:00〜14:00、夜17:00〜21:30、火曜定休、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、20席 (カウンター10、テーブル10)、喫煙所あり。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 夜も昼と同じ値段の定食、カレイの煮付け定食1,300円、いわしの塩焼き、さんま、あじの塩焼き、とんかつ定食、カキフライ、だし巻き、野菜天ぷら、カウンターから選ぶおばんざい定食1,000円、冬は湯豆腐と粕汁、店主は強面だが気さく。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter set-meal shop; pick obanzai at the counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_bar_yanagi.gf_detail: Ask. A whisky and cocktail bar; snacks such as mixed nuts (2025 review).
kyoto_bar_yanagi.vegan_detail: Ask. A bar; cream-free cocktails noted in an older review (2018); snacks such as nuts (2025 review).
kyoto_bar_yanagi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken; often full — a June 2025 visitor phoned ahead (Tabelog; June 2025 review). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; May 2026 review). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 15 counter seats (Tabelog). On Ebisugawa east of Takakura, in a residential area south of the Imperial Palace; 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2023–24 reviews). Relocated from Kita-ku long ago (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_yanagi.notes: [Whisky bar · Ebisugawa near the Imperial Palace] A quiet, moody counter bar of over 40 years, records on the turntable and a deep whisky shelf; tell the calm master your mood and get a recommendation. About ¥2,000–5,000. Smoking allowed. Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer says the bar has been running for over 40 years; Tabelog notes it moved from Shichiku in Kita-ku.

anecdotes.text: Turned away several times when full, a June 2025 visitor phoned ahead and finally got in, finding the owner calm and pleasant.
A May 2026 visitor saw the friendly master serving many international guests with care, and warned that smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バーヤナギ、バー、中京区夷川通高倉東入天守町757、丸太町駅から332m、月〜土 17:00〜24:00、日曜休み、予約可、喫煙可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、15席、北区紫竹から移転。口コミ (2018年〜2026年、英語): 御所南の住宅街、レコードの流れる落ち着いたバー、ウイスキーの品揃え、ハイボール、ジントニック、生ライムのギムレット、マスターのおすすめ、40年以上続く、外国人客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: The master serves many international guests (May 2026 review); smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_teuchi_soba_minagawa_oike.gf_detail: Ask. Coarse-ground seiro is 100% buckwheat (September 2026 review); other soba not described; soy-based tsuyu, tempura (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teuchi_soba_minagawa_oike.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based tsuyu, chicken and duck nanban, tempura (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teuchi_soba_minagawa_oike.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Fri 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–20:30 continuous (last order 20:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings by phone only; queues at lunch; soba can sell out (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし" (its English says a fee may be added). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026 review). No photos inside (October 2026 review). 19 seats: 9 at the counter, 10 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Facing Oike-dori; 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_teuchi_soba_minagawa_oike.notes: [Hand-made soba · Oike-dori] The Oike branch of a long-loved Kitashirakawa soba house: fine, fragrant hand-cut soba — try the coarse 100% buckwheat seiro or summer ume-oroshi — with tempura, duck nanban and sake in the evening. About ¥1,200–2,000 at lunch. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 April 2017 (Tabelog) as the Oike branch of みながわ, long loved in Kitashirakawa, "so more customers can enjoy our handmade soba" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Hand-made soba with sides to enjoy with sake and shochu (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner who joined a queue at opening found the soba thin and mild in aroma, and the tsuyu and wasabi a little scant.
A September 2026 regular noticed prices well up on a few years before, and wondered whether inbound tourism was the cause.
A family arriving late in Silver Week 2026 got the last soba before it ran out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 手打ち蕎麦みながわ 京・御池、そば・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区橋之町755、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、月水木金 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜22:30、土日祝 12:00〜20:30 (通し営業)、火曜休み、電話予約のみ、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー不可、19席 (カウンター9、テーブル10)、禁煙、2017年4月5日オープン、北白川で愛されてきたみながわの御池店。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): ざる、田舎そば、粗挽き十割のせいろ、冷やかけ、夏の冷やし梅おろし1,700円、つけ梅おろし、天せいろ、天おろし、丹波鶏や鴨の南蛮、旬のご飯と小鉢2品のランチセット、蕎麦焼酎の蕎麦湯割り、現金のみ、店内撮影不可、昼は行列、売り切れも、値上がりしたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats facing the kitchen; no photos inside; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_ginjo_kuraudo_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Bluefin tuna sashimi with soy beside menchi katsu, tempura and dan dan noodles (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ginjo_kuraudo_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a tuna and fish izakaya (Tabelog).
kyoto_ginjo_kuraudo_marutamachi.hours_raw: 17:00–23:30 daily (Tabelog). Bookings taken; seats cannot be specified; private rooms for 3 or more; course bookings have a time limit (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「単品のお客様のみチャージ料（付きだし）380円 コースのお客様はかかりません。」 — ¥380 for à la carte guests, none with a course. Cards, e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). 48 seats: counter and tables downstairs, a shoes-off sunken-kotatsu room upstairs; parties up to 26–28 (Tabelog; November 2026 review). A two-storey house on the corner of Ebisugawa and Muromachi; 3 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 6 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ginjo_kuraudo_marutamachi.notes: [Tuna & sake izakaya · Marutamachi] A lively two-storey corner house, the main shop of a small Kyoto group: a ten-cut bluefin "treasure box" for ¥980, creative small plates and some 40 local sakes by the glass, or all-you-can-drink courses. About ¥5,000–7,000. Open daily to 23:30; packed on Fridays.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 May 2019 (Tabelog); the main shop of 吟醸くらうど, with にしき雲 and 京都駅前店 (Tabelog crawl).

anecdotes.text: On a packed Friday in August 2026, a diner's only complaint was being asked to leave at the set time.
Seated upstairs beside a banquet in November 2026, a party of four was asked first whether the noise was all right.
A September 2026 diner warned that the extra-spicy dan dan noodles are hotter than most.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 本鮪と創作和食 吟醸くらうど 丸太町本店、居酒屋・魚介料理・日本酒バー、中京区鏡屋町50-2、丸太町駅6番出口から徒歩3分、夷川通と室町通の角の二階建て、17:00〜23:30、無休、予約可 (席の指定不可)、単品のお客様のみチャージ料 (付きだし) 380円・コースはなし、48席 (カウンター8、テーブル16、掘りごたつ24)、個室、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、2019年5月9日オープン、本鮪の玉手箱 (10種) 一人980円、地酒約40種を580円。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 赤雲コース、飲み放題、里芋のポテサラ、豆乳だし巻きサンド、鯖の塩焼き、メンチカツ、寿司、いちじくの天ぷら、里芋の唐揚げ、あおさの卵焼き、トロたく、担々麺、時間制、2階の掘りごたつ。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off upstairs; course time limits.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_wine_gura_shiori.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan dishes, gyoza in tomato sauce, pizza and pasta beside grilled squid and vegetables (2026 reviews).
kyoto_wine_gura_shiori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood, beef tendon, cheese dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_wine_gura_shiori.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00 daily (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed 31 December–1 January (Tabelog). Bookings taken; seat-only bookings need one drink and one dish each; stays capped at 3 hours (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「■先付：480円／コース時は除く」 — a ¥480 appetizer, not with courses. Unlimited all-you-can-drink ¥3,200; courses of 8 dishes ¥6,600 or 9 dishes ¥7,700 with drinks (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 42 seats: counter, private tables and sunken-kotatsu rooms for 3–8, a hall for 30; non-smoking (Tabelog). Order by wine number; call button at tables (2026 reviews). On Shichijo-dori; 5 min from Kyoto Stn, reachable by the underground walkway (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
kyoto_wine_gura_shiori.notes: [Teppan & wine · near Kyoto Station] A Japanese-style room full of wine bottles, popular for group dinners: creative teppan plates and around 13 all-you-can-drink wines ordered by number, with private kotatsu rooms. Courses with drinks ¥6,600–7,700; ¥480 appetizer à la carte. Open daily from 16:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a creative teppan restaurant and wine bar 5 minutes from Kyoto Station.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 banquet host found the drinks so slow to come that the toast was delayed, and the call button went unanswered — "not suitable for banquets".
A September 2026 regular who brings mostly female groups praised ordering wine by number and fast glass changes.
An October 2026 company party found it quiet and free of tourist crowds, but went for ramen afterwards as the food was limited.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Wine蔵しおり、居酒屋・鉄板焼き・ダイニングバー、下京区七条通新町東入ル西境町158、JR京都駅から徒歩5分、16:00〜23:00、12月31日・1月1日休み、先付480円 (コース時は除く)、席のみ予約はワンドリンク・ワンオーダー、最長3時間、飲み放題3,200円、コース8品6,600円・9品7,700円、42席 (カウンター、個室テーブル、掘りごたつ個室、30名の大広間)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): ワイン13種の飲み放題 (番号で注文)、鉄板のいか、なすとズッキーニのチーズ焼き、トマトソースの餃子、牛すじのオムレツ、ピザ、パスタ、ホタテフライ、うずらとミニトマトのピンチョス、アリゴ、宴会には向かないという声、店員の声が大きいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order drinks by number; private rooms.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_chander_marutamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: naan-led sets; samosas; rice and biryani exist, but a shared tandoor and fryer are likely — no allergen information in the sources (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_chander_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a vegetable set with two vegetable curries (2022–2023), but ghee, cream and cheese are not ruled out.
kyoto_chander_marutamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; hours may change. Basement of the Palestate Nissei building, across the road from Kumano Shrine. 35 seats, about eight tables for four (2022–2023 reviews); private hire possible. Tabelog lists smoking as allowed (check on arrival). No e-money or QR; cards not listed — one diner saw no card signs and paid cash (October 2022). Spice level 1–5 chosen when ordering.
kyoto_chander_marutamachi.notes: [Indian · Kumano Shrine, big naan and student lunches] A basement Indian restaurant across from Kumano Shrine, packed with students at lunch: curry sets with huge naan (the cheese naan is the favourite), biryani, a five-step spice scale and free naan refills for students. Food can be slow at peak (2022); one diner suspected the fancier naans were never made (October 2022). One of at least three Chander shops in Kyoto.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2019 to 2026 describe a half-basement room with Ganesha decorations, Indian staff who speak fluent Japanese and talk among themselves in another language, a manager who asks whether the food was spicy enough, and a lunch crowd of students. Other Chander shops are listed by Tabelog near Kitayama Station and in front of Kyoto University's main gate.

anecdotes.text: October 2022: asked for fruit naan, "they informed me that it was sold out, but they had cheese and butter naan available… I suspected that they might not have prepared the less popular items."
March 2026: "The cheerful Indian staff welcomed me and helped me navigate through the extensive menu with their fluent Japanese," and a lassi came free.
June 2022: a diner had stayed away "because I heard it took a long time for the food to arrive."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: CHANDER 丸太町店、インド料理、左京区聖護院山王町43-2 パレステート日生ビル B1F、市バス熊野神社前、神宮丸太町駅から529m、毎日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00、35席、貸切可、喫煙可、電子マネー・QR不可、ベジタリアン対応。口コミ (2019年11月〜2026年3月、英語): 熊野神社の向かいの半地下、ガネーシャの飾り、インド人のスタッフ、テーブル4人席が8つほど、辛さは5段階、ナンカレーセット850円 (2022年)、ポークサグ1,020円、Dランチ1,280円、Lurki セット1,460円 (2023年)、野菜セットとサモサ、チーズナンは+320円、ナンは12種類、チキンビリヤニ、学生はナン食べ放題、昼は学生で混む、ナンが大きく持ち帰りも可、料理が出るのが遅いという噂、フルーツナンは品切れと言われたという声、カードの表示がなく現金で払ったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Indian staff with fluent Japanese; choose a spice level 1–5.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_teppanyaki_nijo_anacp.gf_detail: Ask: teppan beef, seafood and vegetables, but soy sauce, ponzu and miso are among the steak condiments (July 2018) and garlic rice is cooked on the same plate; no allergen information in the sources.
kyoto_teppanyaki_nijo_anacp.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef, foie gras and seafood courses (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppanyaki_nijo_anacp.hours_raw: Tabelog and hotel site: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday, open when Wednesday is a public holiday. Booking advised. Service charge 10%, no cover charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料10%、チャージ料なし」. 19 seats: a 13-seat counter and one private room for 6. Non-smoking; English menu; birthday plates; cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), QUICPay, PayPay. Hotel parking (4 hours free when dining); shuttle bus from Kyoto Station. Opened 25 June 1986 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppanyaki_nijo_anacp.notes: [Teppanyaki · Nijo Castle, a 1986 hotel counter] The ANA Crowne Plaza's basement teppanyaki counter since 1986: foie gras, the day's seafood and domestic beef fillet grilled in front of you, garlic rice to finish — a quiet, unflashy family-celebration place with lunch courses far cheaper than dinner. One diner found the dishes other than the meat forgettable (September 2022); another wished the chef said where the abalone and beef came from (June 2026). 10% service charge. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Not named in a source; restaurant of the ANA Crowne Plaza Kyoto
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 June 1986 in the basement of the hotel by Nijo Castle (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2017 to 2026 describe a spacious counter where the chef cooks and chats, a family that has marked birthdays here for years with special plates, and a "traditional" teppan style without flambé or show.

anecdotes.text: July 2022: "If you're looking for a flashy Teppan-yaki, look elsewhere" — the reviewer came for "the traditional Teppan-yaki style that is slowly fading away."
"For years, it has been our family's go-to place for celebrations, including birthdays where they always prepare a special plate for us." — December 2018.
September 2022: "delicious meat, but unfortunately, the other dishes didn't leave a lasting impression."
June 2026: "I would have loved more information about the ingredients… For example, where the abalone and meat are sourced from."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二条、鉄板焼・ステーキ、中京区堀川通二条下ル土橋町10 ANAクラウンプラザホテル京都 B1F、二条城前駅2番出口から徒歩約1分、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜休み (祝日は営業)、原文で「サービス料10%、チャージ料なし」、19席 (カウンター13席、6名の個室1室)、禁煙、英語メニュー、カード・QUICPay・PayPay可、ホテル駐車場、京都駅からシャトルバス、1986年6月25日オープン。ホテルの公式サイト: 鉄板焼 二条、水曜定休 (祝日を除く)。口コミ (2017年6月〜2026年6月、英語): 御池・堀川・壬生のランチコース、フォアグラのステーキ、本日の魚介、国産牛フィレ100g、焼野菜、ガーリックライスと赤だし、白身魚のトマトバジルソース、あわびと黒毛和牛への変更、隣の四川料理店の Chen Kentaro の麻婆豆腐 (+900円)、誕生日のプレート、派手さのない昔ながらの鉄板焼、肉以外は印象に残らないという声、食材の産地の説明がほしいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; English menu; 10% service charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through June 2026; hotel site lists it.
